classFeatures.name: 神聖感知
entries: 強大的邪惡對你來說就像是令人作嘔的臭氣，而強大的善良在你的耳中就如同仙樂般鳴響。以一個動作，你可以擴張你的意識以偵測這類力量。直到你的下個回合結束前，你知曉任何距離你60呎內，且未處於全掩護的天界生物、邪魔、或不死生物的位置。你知曉被你感知到的存在的種類（天界生物、邪魔、或不死生物），但無法知曉它的身分（例如吸血鬼伯爵，斯特拉德．馮．扎洛維奇）。在同樣的範圍內，你也可以偵測到任何被像是{@spell 聖居}法術給祝聖或褻瀆的場所或物體。
你可以使用這個能力的次數等同於1+你的魅力調整值。當你完成一次長休，你恢復所有你花費掉的次數。

classFeatures.name: 聖療
entries: 你祝福的碰觸可以醫治傷口。你擁有一個治療能量池，會在你每次長休後補滿。藉由治療能量池，你可以回復總共等同於你聖騎士等級 x 5的生命值。
以一個動作，你可以觸碰一個生物並汲取治療池中的能量以讓該生物回復一定數量的生命值，最多等同於你治療池中剩餘的數量。
或者，你可以消耗你治療池中的5點生命值，以治療或中和一個正影響目標的疾病或毒素。你可以使用一次聖療治療複數個疾病並中和複數個毒素，但你必須為各疾病和毒素分別支付治療池中的生命值。
這個能力對不死生物和構裝體沒有任何效果。

classFeatures.name: 至聖斬
entries: 從2級開始，當你使用一次近戰武器攻擊命中一個生物，除了武器傷害以外，你可以消耗一個法術位以對目標造成額外的光耀傷害。這個額外傷害在消耗1環法術位時為{@dice 2d8}點，高於一環的法術位則每環再加上{@dice 1d8}點傷害，最高至{@dice 5d8}。若目標為不死生物或邪魔，則傷害再增加{@dice 1d8}點，最高至{@dice 6d8}。

classFeatures.name: 戰鬥風格
entries: 在2級時，你採用一種特殊的戰鬥風格以做為你的專業。從下列選項中選擇一種。你不能獲得相同的戰鬥風格選項超過一次，即使你有機會再選擇它也一樣。

entries.name: 近身射手
entries: 當你在距離一個敵意生物5呎以內時進行一次遠程攻擊，你在該攻擊檢定中並不會具有劣勢。你的遠程攻擊忽略距離你30呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊的攻擊檢定中獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 防禦
entries: 當你穿戴護甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 決鬥
entries: 當你單手持用一把近戰武器，且沒有持用其他武器時，你在使用該武器所進行的傷害骰中獲得+2加值。

entries.name: 巨武戰鬥
entries: 當你在使用一把以雙手持用的近戰武器所進行攻擊的傷害骰中骰出了1或2的結果，你可以重骰該骰，且必須使用新的擲骰結果，即使其結果仍然是1或2。該武器必須具有雙手或可雙手屬性才能讓你獲得這個好處。

entries.name: 水手
entries: 只要你未穿戴重甲或使用盾牌，你就擁有等同於你正常移動速度的游泳速度和攀爬速度，且你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 守護
entries: 當一個你所能看見的生物攻擊一個距離你5呎內你以外的目標，你可以使用你的反應以讓該攻擊檢定承受劣勢。你必須持握一面盾牌。

entries.name: 坑道鬥士
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以進入防禦架式並持續直到你的下個回合開始。當你處於防禦架式時，你可以進行藉機攻擊而無需使用你的反應，且你可以處於你觸及範圍內的生物移動超過5呎時使用你的反應對它進行一次近戰攻擊。

classFeatures.name: 施法
entries: 從2級起，你學會了如牧師一般透過冥想和祈禱利用神聖魔法。請參閱{@book 第十章|PHB|10}以了解關於施法的規則，以及第十一章以查閱{@filter 聖騎士法術列表|spells|class=paladin}。

entries.name: 準備及施放法術
entries: 聖騎士表中顯示了你有多少個法術位可以用來施放你一環或更高環的{@filter 聖騎士法術|spells|class=paladin}。要施放其中一個這些法術，你必須消耗一個與該法術環階相同或更高的法術位。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的法術位。
你準備一份你所能施放的聖騎士法術列表，從聖騎士法術列表中選擇。當你這麼做時，選擇數量等同於你魅力調整值 + 你聖騎士等級的一半（向下取整）的聖騎士法術（最少一個法術）。這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。
舉例來說，如果你是一個5級的聖騎士，你擁有四個1環和二個2環的法術位。你的魅力為14，則你已準備法術的列表中可以包含總共四個1環或2環的法術。若你準備了1環法術{@spell 治療傷勢}，你可以使用1環和2環的法術位來施放它。施放法術並不會將它從你的準備法術列表中移除。
你可以在你完成一次長休時改變你的準備法術列表。準備一份新的聖騎士法術列表需要花費時間於祈禱和冥想：你需要為你列表上每個法術的每個環階都花費至少1分鐘的時間。

entries.name: 施法屬性
entries: 因為你法術的能量源自於你信仰的強度，魅力是你施展聖騎士法術的施法屬性。每當一個法術提及你的施法屬性時，你將使用你的魅力。此外，當決定你聖騎士法術的豁免DC、以及使用聖騎士法術進行攻擊檢定時，你使用你的魅力調整值。

entries.name: 施法法器
entries: 你可以使用一個{@item 聖徽|phb}（第五章），來做為你施放聖騎士法術的法器。

classFeatures.name: 神性體魄
entries: 從3級起，在你體內湧動的神聖魔法使你免疫於疾病。

classFeatures.name: 神聖誓言
entries: 當你升至3級時，你立下永遠做為聖騎士的神聖誓言。在此之前，你僅是處於準備階段，投身於這條道途，但尚未立誓遵從它。現在，你從可選的聖誓列表中選擇一個。
你的選擇將在3級、7級、15級、和20級時賦予你新的能力。這些能力包括了聖誓法術以及引導神力能力。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 每個聖誓都具有一張關聯法術列表。你將在升至各聖誓說明中指定的聖騎士等級時獲得這些法術。一旦你獲得聖誓法術，你將永遠視作已經準備了它，且它不會計入你每日可準備的法術數量中。
若你獲得一個不在聖騎士法術列表上的聖誓法術，則該法術對你而言仍然視作聖騎士法術。

entries.name: 引導神力
entries: 你的聖誓允許你引導神聖能量以驅動魔法效果。每個由你的聖誓所提供的引導神力都會說明使用它的方式。
當你使用你的引導神力時，你選擇要使用哪一個選項。你接著必須完成一次短休或長休後才能再使用你的引導神力。
某些引導神力的效果會需要豁免檢定。當你使用本職業的這類效果時，其DC等同於你的聖騎士法術豁免DC。

entries.name: 背棄誓言
entries: 聖騎士嘗試於使自己符合最高的道德標準，但即使是最具美德的聖騎士也會犯錯。有時是因為正確的道路太過高不可攀，有時當下的情境迫使你在兩害相權取其輕，而有時狂熱的激情則會讓聖騎士的違背了他或她的誓言。
背棄誓言的聖騎士通常會向相同信仰的牧師或相同教團的聖騎士尋求赦罪。聖騎士可能會花費一整晚守夜祈禱以做為他懺悔的證明，或者齋戒禁食以表示自我否定，或者採取一個快速或類似的克己舉動。在執行認罪和饒恕的儀式後，聖騎士便重獲純潔。
若一個聖騎士蓄意地違背了他或她的誓言，且沒有展現出任何悔過的跡象，後果可能會更加嚴重。根據DM的裁斷，一個不知悔悟的聖騎士可能被迫放棄此職業而過繼為另一個職業，或是採用記載於《地下城主指南》中的破誓聖騎士選項。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至4級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 額外攻擊
entries: 從5級開始，每當你在你的回合採取{@action 攻擊}動作，你可以攻擊二次，而非一次。

classFeatures.name: 守護靈光
entries: 從6級開始，每當你或一個距離你10呎內的友善生物必須進行一次豁免檢定，該生物在該豁免檢定中獲得等同於你魅力調整值的加值（最少為+1）。你必須要意識清醒才能提供這個加值。
在18級時，這道靈光的範圍增加至30呎。

classFeatures.name: 神聖誓言能力
entries: 在7級時，你獲得一個由你神聖誓言所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至8級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 勇氣靈光
entries: 從10級開始，你和任何距離你10呎內的友善生物不會在你意識清醒的時候陷入{@condition 恐懼}。
在18級時，這道靈光的範圍增加至30呎。

classFeatures.name: 強化至聖斬
entries: 從11級起，你是如此的充滿公義之力，以至於你的所有近戰武器打擊都帶著神聖的能量。每當你使用一把近戰武器命中一個生物，該生物將受到額外的{@dice 1d8}光耀傷害。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至12級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 淨化之觸
entries: 從14級開始，你可以使用你的動作以結束一個作用於你自己或一個你所碰觸自願生物的法術。
你可以使用這個能力的次數等同於你的魅力調整值（最少一次）。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的次數。

classFeatures.name: 神聖誓言能力
entries: 在15級時，你獲得一個由你神聖誓言所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至16級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 靈光強化
entries: 在18級時，你的靈光的範圍增加至30呎。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至19級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 神聖誓言能力
entries: 在20級時，你獲得一個由你神聖誓言所賦予的能力。

subclassFeatures.name: 遠古之誓
entries: 遠古之誓就和精靈種族、以及德魯伊的教儀一樣古老。那些立下此聖誓的聖騎士們有時又被稱作「妖精騎士」、「綠之騎士」、「角冠騎士」，他們之所以在宇宙間的正邪之戰中投身於光明一方以對抗黑暗，是因為他們熱愛那存在於世界上的美以及生命，而並不一定是因為心懷榮耀、勇氣、和正直信念。他們在盔甲和服飾上飾以樹葉、鹿角、花朵等等生機勃勃物品的紋樣，以反映他們保護世界上的生命和光明的承諾。

entries.name: 遠古之信條
entries: 遠古之誓的信條已經被傳承了無數個世紀。這個誓言強調善良的準則高於一切秩序和混亂。它的四個核心準則相當單純。

entries.name: 點燃光明
entries: 透過你慈憫、和善、和寬恕的行動，在世界中點燃希望之光，讓絕望在你面前退散。

entries.name: 守護明光
entries: 世界上何處有善、美、愛、和歡笑，你就起身對抗那將吞噬它們的邪惡。何處有繁盛興旺的生命，你就起身對抗那將使之歸於貧瘠的力量。

entries.name: 維持己身光輝
entries: 欣喜於歌聲和歡笑，悅樂於美和藝術。若你讓自己心中的光明殞落，你就無法保護世上的光明。

entries.name: 成為真光
entries: 成為絕望者眼中的輝煌明燈。在你的所有行為中都閃耀出樂觀和勇氣的光輝。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 遠古之誓法術
rows: {@spell 誘捕打擊}, {@spell 動物交談術}
{@spell 植物滋長}, {@spell 防護能量}

entries.name: 引導神力：自然之怒
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力並喚起原初之力以捕縛一個敵人。以一個動作，你可以讓靈體藤蔓生長而出並纏向一個距離你10呎內，且你所能看見的生物。該生物必須成功通過一次力量或敏捷豁免（由它選擇），否則陷入{@condition 束縛}狀態。當被這些藤蔓{@condition 束縛}時，該生物將在每個它的回合結束時重複此豁免檢定。若豁免成功，則它將掙脫束縛，且這些藤蔓也將消失。

entries.name: 引導神力：驅散無信者
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力以喊出一句將讓聽到的精類和邪魔都感到痛苦的禱言。以一個動作，你展現你的聖徽，且每個距離你30呎內且能聽見你的精類或邪魔都必須進行一次睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將被驅散長達1分鐘或直到它受到傷害。
一個被驅散的精類和邪魔必須用它的回合嘗試盡可能的遠離你，且它無法自願的移動到距離你30呎內的空間。它無法採取反應。它的動作只能使用{@action 疾走}動作或嘗試掙脫阻止它移動的效果。若它無法移動，則該生物將使用{@action 閃避}動作。
若該生物的真實型態因為幻象、變形、或其他效果而被遮蔽，則它的真實型態將在它被驅散時被揭露。

entries.name: 防護靈光
entries: 從7級開始，眷顧著你的遠古魔法是如此強大，以至於在你身上形成了可畏的防護。你和距離你10呎內的友善生物都將獲得對法術傷害的抗性。
在18級時，這個靈光的範圍將增加至30呎。

entries.name: 不朽衛士
entries: 從15級開始，當你的生命值被歸零且沒有被當場殺死時，你可以選擇改為將生命值減少至1。一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。
此外，你將免受任何衰老的弊害，且你不會被魔法變老。

entries.name: 遠古鬥士
entries: 在20級時，你可以變作大自然遠古力量化身的型態，獲得你所選擇的外貌特徵。舉例來說，你的肌膚可能會變成綠色或呈現樹皮般的質地、你的頭髮可能會變得如樹葉或青苔一般、或者你可能會長出鹿角或獅子般的鬃毛。
使用你的動作，你將經歷這個變化過程。在接下來1分鐘內，你將獲得下列好處：

items: 在你的每個回合開始時，你回復10點生命值。
每當你施放一個施法時間為一個動作的聖騎士法術，你可以改為以你的附贈動作施放它。
距離你10呎內的敵對生物將在對抗你聖騎士法術和引導神力選項的豁免檢定中具有劣勢。

entries: 一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: 奉獻之誓
entries: 奉獻之誓約束著聖騎士遵從正義、美德、和秩序中最崇高的理念。那些立下此聖誓的聖騎士們有時又被稱作「騎兵」、「白騎士」、或「聖戰士」，他們的行為舉止符合騎士的完美典範：身著閃亮的盔甲、行為中帶著榮耀，並追尋著公正和大義。這些聖騎士用最高的道德標準要求自己，而其中一些人，無論好壞，也以相同的標準去要求其他人。許多立下此聖誓的聖騎士都獻身於守序和善良之神，並以他們神祇的戒律衡量他們奉獻的程度。他們將天使—完美的至善侍從—視作他們的理想，並在頭盔或盾徽上飾以天使羽翼的形象。

entries.name: 奉獻之信條
entries: 儘管奉獻之誓的實際內容和限制各有不同，但立下此誓的聖騎士都共有以下這些信條。

entries.name: 誠實
entries: 不要說謊或欺詐。你言出必行。

entries.name: 勇氣
entries: 儘管謹慎是明智的，但絕不可畏懼行動。

entries.name: 憐憫
entries: 援助他人，保護弱小，並懲罰恃強凌弱者。憐憫你的敵人，但要以智慧懲治他們。

entries.name: 榮譽
entries: 以公平待人，讓你榮譽的行為成為他們的典範。盡力行善，避免造成不必要的傷害。

entries.name: 盡責
entries: 對你的行為和其後果負責，守護那些你負責照顧的人，並遵從你理應服從之人。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 奉獻之誓法術
rows: {@spell 次級復原術}, {@spell 誠實之域}
{@spell 希望信標}, {@spell 解除魔法}
{@spell 行動自如術}, {@spell 虔誠守衛}

entries.name: 引導神力：至聖武器
entries: 以一個動作，你可以將正能量注入一把你正持握的武器，使用你的引導神力。在1分鐘內，你在使用該武器進行的攻擊檢定中加入你的魅力調整值（加值最低為+1）。該武器同時將散發出20呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸20呎的微光光照。若該武器原本不是魔法武器，則它將在持續期間變成一把魔法武器。
你可以在你的回合做為任何其他動作的一部份結束這個效果。若你不再持握或攜帶該武器，或若你陷入{@condition 昏迷}狀態，則此效果結束。

entries.name: 引導神力：驅散不潔者
entries: 以一個動作，你展現你的聖徽並說出一句斥責邪魔和不死生物的禱詞，使用你的引導神力。每個距離你30呎內且可以看見或聽見你的邪魔和不死生物都必須進行一次睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將被驅散長達1分鐘或直到它受到傷害。
一個被驅散的不死生物必須用它的回合嘗試盡可能的遠離你，且它無法自願的移動到距離你30呎內的空間。它無法採取反應。它的動作只能使用{@action 疾走}動作或嘗試掙脫阻止它移動的效果。若它無法移動，則該生物將使用{@action 閃避}動作。

entries.name: 奉獻靈光
entries: 從7級開始，你和距離你10呎內的友善生物都不會在你意識清醒的時候被{@condition 魅惑}。
在18級時，這個靈光的範圍將增加至30呎。

entries.name: 純淨之魂
entries: 從15級開始，你將永遠處於{@spell 防護善惡}法術的效果影響。

entries.name: 神聖光輪
entries: 在20級時，以一個動作，你可以放射出一道日光靈光。在1分鐘內，你將散發出30呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸30呎的微光光照。
每當一個敵對生物在此明亮光照的範圍內開始它的回合，該生物將受到10點光耀傷害。
此外，在持續期間內，你在對抗由邪魔或不死生物所施放法術的豁免檢定中具有優勢。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: 復仇之誓
entries: 復仇之誓是個嚴肅的承諾，立誓於懲罰那些犯下嚴重罪行之人。當邪惡勢力屠殺無辜的百姓、當全體人民背離了神祇的旨意、當盜賊公會茁壯得太過殘暴和強大、或當巨龍橫行於鄉野—在這種時刻，聖騎士們就會出現，並立下復仇之誓以彰顯他們撥亂反正的決心。對這些聖騎士—有時又被稱作「復仇者」、或「黑暗騎士」—而言，他們自身的純潔遠不如伸張正義來的重要。

entries.name: 復仇之信條
entries: 復仇之誓的信條對每個聖騎士而言都各有不同，但這些信條全都圍繞著以任何必要手段懲罰有過者。高舉這些信條的聖騎士甚至願意犧牲他們的正直以讓正義降臨在惡者身上，也因此，這些聖騎士的陣營通常會是絕對中立或守序中立。這些信條的核心原則極其簡單。

entries.name: 追尋以迎戰大惡
entries: 是要追獵誓敵？抑或驅逐小惡？我選擇迎戰那更大的邪惡。

entries.name: 對惡徒不留慈悲
entries: 尋常敵人可能贏得我的慈悲，但我的誓敵無可憐憫。

entries.name: 為目的不擇手段
entries: 我的擔憂疑慮永不會阻止我殲滅敵人。

entries.name: 為惡行盡力補償
entries: 若我的敵人在這世界上造成了破壞，那必是因我沒能成功阻止它。我必須幫助那些因其惡行而被傷害的人們。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 復仇之誓法術
rows: {@spell 人類定身術}, {@spell 迷蹤步}

entries.name: 引導神力：誓絕仇敵
entries: 以一個動作，你展現你的聖徽並說出斥責的禱詞，使用你的引導神力。選擇一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物。該生物必須進行一次睿知豁免，除非它免疫於{@condition 恐懼}。邪魔和不死生物將在此豁免檢定中具有劣勢。
若豁免失敗，該生物將陷入{@condition 恐懼}長達1分鐘，或直到它受到任何傷害。當處於{@condition 恐懼}時，該生物的移動速度歸零，且無法得益於任何對它移動速度的加值。
若豁免成功，該生物的移動速度被減半長達1分鐘，或直到該生物受到任何傷害。

entries.name: 引導神力：憎恨誓言
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以使用你的引導神力，對一個距離你10呎內且你所能看見的生物立下憎恨誓言。你對該生物所進行的攻擊檢定將具有優勢，持續1分鐘，或直到它的生命值歸零或陷入{@condition 昏迷}狀態。

entries.name: 無盡復仇
entries: 從7級起，你的超常專注將協助你阻止敵人撤退。當你以一次藉機攻擊命中一個生物時，你可以在攻擊之後做為該反應的一部份，立刻移動最多等同於你移動速度一半的距離。這個移動並不會引發藉機攻擊。

entries.name: 報復之魂
entries: 從15級開始，你立下憎恨誓言時所帶有的權威將賦予你更強的力量以對抗你的敵人。當一個處於你憎恨誓言效果下的生物進行一次攻擊，若該生物處於你的近戰武器攻擊範圍內，你可以使用你的反應以對它進行一次近戰武器攻擊。

entries.name: 復仇天使
entries: 在20級時，你可以變作天使般復仇者的型態。使用你的動作，你將經歷這個變化過程。在接下來1小時內，你將獲得下列好處：

items: 你的背上將長出雙翼，並賦予你60呎的飛行速度。
你將散發出30呎半徑的威嚇靈光。任何敵對生物在第一次進入這道靈光、或在戰鬥期間於該處開始它回合時，該生物都必須成功通過一次睿知豁免，否則因你而陷入{@condition 恐懼}長達1分鐘，或直到它受到任何傷害。對該被{@condition 恐懼}生物所進行的攻擊檢定將具有優勢。

entries: 一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: 破誓者
entries: 成為破誓者的聖騎士打破了自己的神聖誓言，而去追求黑暗的野心或為邪惡力量服務。聖騎士心中燃燒的光耀已經熄滅，只剩下一片黑暗。
只有至少達到3級的邪惡聖騎士才能成為一名破誓者。該聖騎士將用破誓者特性替換其所有對應神聖哲言的特性。

entries.name: 破誓者法術
entries: 你會在列出的聖騎士等級獲得破誓者法術。

entries.caption: 破誓者法術
rows: {@spell 煉獄叱喝}, {@spell 造成傷勢}

entries.name: 破誓者引導神力：控制亡靈
entries: 以一個動作，該聖騎士指定其身邊30尺內一個他能看見的不死生物。該目標必須進程一次睿知豁免。豁免失敗時，該目標必須在隨後的24小時裡遵從該聖騎士的命令，或者直至該聖騎士在此使用該引導神力選項為止。挑戰等級等於或高於該聖騎士等級的不死生物免疫該效應。

entries.name: 破誓者引導神力：恐怖顯現
entries: 以一個動作，該聖騎士引導最黑暗的情感並將其凝聚爆發為一場魔法的脅迫之息。該聖騎士周邊30尺內，其指定的每個能看到該聖騎士的生物必須進行一次睿知豁免。豁免失敗的目標將陷入1分鐘對該聖騎士恐慌的狀態。因該效應陷入恐慌的生物如果在距離該聖騎士30尺外的位置結束其自己回合，則其可以嘗試再進行一次該睿知豁免，豁免成功則終止其自己身上的該效應。

entries.name: 憎恨靈光
entries: 第7級起，該聖騎士本身，以及其身邊10尺內的所有邪魔和不死生物，都將獲的與該聖騎士魅力調整值相同(至少為+1)的近戰武器傷害擲般加值。一個生物一次只能從一名聖騎士的該特性中獲益。
第18級時，該靈光的覆蓋範圍增加至30尺。

entries.name: 超然抗性
entries: 第15級時，該聖騎士獲得對非魔法武器的鈍擊、刺穿、揮砍傷害的抗性。

entries.name: 恐懼之王
entries: 第20級時，以一個動作，該聖騎士可以使自己在1分鐘內環繞於陰鬱的靈光中。該靈光可以將該聖騎士周邊30尺半徑的亮光光照減弱為微光光照。任何受該聖騎士恐慌的敵人在該靈光內開始其自己回合時將受到4d10的心靈傷害。此外，該聖騎士以及由其指定的身處靈光中的生物都將籠罩於更深的幽影中。依賴視覺的生物對籠罩於該幽影中的生物發動攻擊檢定時具有劣勢。
靈光持續時，該聖騎士可以在其自己回合內用一個附贈動作令該靈光內的幽影攻擊一個生物。該聖騎士對該目標發動一次近戰法術攻擊。若攻擊命中，則該目標受到的黯蝕傷害等於3d10+該聖騎士的魅力調整值。
激活該靈光後，該聖騎士必須完成一次長休才能再次使用該特性。

subclassFeatures.name: 王冠之誓
entries: 王冠之誓是一種對於文明理想的宣誓，無論是對國家精神的認同、對君王的效忠、或是對律法和統治之神的奉侍。立下王冠之誓的聖武士們致力於服務社會，尤其是那維繫著社會的法律。這些聖騎士們是城牆上警醒的守衛，挺身對抗那威脅於摧毀文明世界的野蠻混亂浪潮；他們通常被稱作守護者、典範者、或是哨衛。通常，立下這個誓言的聖騎士會是效忠於國家或者君王的騎士團中的成員，而接受這個誓言也是他們加入騎士團階級的一部分條件。

entries.name: 王冠之信條
entries: 王冠之誓的信條通常是由其宣誓效忠的君王所設立，但一般而言這些信條都會強調著下列幾項。

entries.name: 律法
entries: 律法至上。它是文明的基石，且必須被敬重。

entries.name: 忠誠
entries: 言出必行。失去了忠誠，誓言和律法將毫無意義。

entries.name: 勇氣
entries: 無所畏懼。你必須自願為了秩序挺身而出，即使勝算渺茫。如果你不行動，又有誰會呢？

entries.name: 責任
entries: 恪盡職守。你必須為你的行動承擔後果，且你有責任去實現你的使命和義務。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 王冠之誓法術
rows: {@spell 守護聯結}, {@spell 誠實之域}
{@spell 活力靈光}, {@spell 靈體守衛}

entries.name: 引導神力：捍衛挑戰
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你發起一個挑戰以強迫其他生物與你戰鬥。每個距離你30呎內你所選且你能看見的生物必須進行一次睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將無法自願移動到距離你超過30呎範圍的位置。這個效果對該生物的影響會在你陷入{@condition 無力}狀態或死亡、或該生物距離你超過30呎時提早結束。

entries.name: 引導神力：扭轉局勢
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以用你的引導神力援助重傷的生物。每個距離你30呎內你所選且能聽見你的生物若只有不超過一半的生命值，則將回復等同於{@dice 1d6}+你的魅力調整值（至少為1）的生命值。

entries.name: 神聖忠誠
entries: 從7級開始，當一個距離你5呎內的生物受到傷害，你可以使用你的反應以魔法性地讓你的生命值代替該目標生物，使該生物不受傷害。取而代之，你受到該傷害。這個對你造成的傷害無法被任何方式減輕或避免。

entries.name: 不屈之魂
entries: 從15級開始，你在用於避免被{@condition 麻痺}或{@condition 震懾}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: 崇高衛士
entries: 在20級時，你在戰場上的姿態對那些致力於你事業的人們而言是一種強大的鼓舞。你可以使用你的動作以獲得下列好處長達1小時：

items: 你對非魔法武器所造成的鈍擊、穿刺、劈砍傷害具有抗性。
你的盟友在處於你30呎範圍內時在死亡豁免中具有優勢。
你以及距離你30呎內的盟友在睿知豁免中具有優勢。

entries: 這個效果會在你陷入{@condition 無力}狀態或死亡時提早結束。一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: Oath of Conquest
entries: The Oath of Conquest calls to paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies. It isn't enough for these paladins to establish order. They must crush the forces of chaos. Sometimes called knight tyrants or iron mongers, those who swear this oath gather into grim orders that serve gods or philosophies of war and well-ordered might. Some of these paladins go so far as to consort with the powers of the Nine Hells. The archdevil Bel, warlord of Avernus, counts many of these paladins called hell knights as his most ardent supporters. Hell knights cover their armor with trophies taken from fallen enemies, a grim warning to any who dare oppose them and the decrees of their lords.

entries.name: Tenets of Conquest
entries: A paladin who takes this oath has the tenets of conquest seared on the upper arm. A hell knight's oath appears in Infernal runes, a brutal reminder of vows to the Lords of Hell.

entries.name: Douse the Flame of Hope
entries: It is not enough to merely defeat an enemy in battle. Your victory must be so overwhelming that your enemies will to fight is shattered forever. A blade can end a life. Fear can end an empire.

entries.name: Rule with an Iron Fist
entries: Once you have conquered, tolerate no dissent. Your word is law. Those who obey it shall be favored. Those who defy it shall be punished as an example to all who might follow.

entries.name: Strength Above All
entries: You shall rule until a stronger one arises. Then you must grow mightier and meet the challenge, or fall to your own ruin.

entries.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

entries.caption: Oath of Conquest Spells
rows: {@spell 艾嘉西斯之鎧}, {@spell 命令術}
{@spell 人類定身術}, {@spell 靈體武器}
{@spell 支配人類}, {@spell 疫病蟲群}

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Strike
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to break a foe's will. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack as part of the {@action Attack} action, you can also use your Channel Divinity to force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

entries.name: Aura of Conquest
entries: Starting at 7th level, you emanate a menacing aura while you're not {@condition incapacitated}. The aura includes your space, extends 10 feet from you in every direction, and is blocked by total cover. Any enemy in the aura has disadvantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

entries.name: Implacable Spirit
entries: Once you reach 15th level, you can no longer be {@condition charmed}.

entries.name: Invincible Conqueror
entries: At 20th level, you gain the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As an action, you can magically become an avatar of conquest, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to all damage.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as part of that action.
Your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Oath of Conquest v2
entries: The Oath of Conquest calls to paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies. It isn't enough for these paladins to establish order. They must crush the forces of chaos. Sometimes called knight tyrants or iron mongers, those who swear this oath gather into grim orders that serve gods or philosophies of war and well-ordered might.

Some of these paladins go so far as to consort with the powers of the Nine Hells, valuing the rule of law over the balm of mercy. The archdevil Bel, warlord of Avernus, counts many of these paladins—called hell knights—as his most ardent supporters. Hell knights cover their armor with trophies taken from fallen enemies, a grim warning to any who dare oppose them and the decrees of their lords. These knights are often most fiercely resisted by other paladins of this oath, who believe that the hell knights have wandered too far into darkness.

entries.name: Tenets of Conquest
entries: A paladin who takes this oath has the tenets of conquest seared on the upper arm. A hell knight's oath appears in Infernal runes, a brutal reminder of vows to the Lords of Hell.

entries.name: Douse the Flame of Hope
entries: It is not enough to merely defeat an enemy in battle. Your victory must be so overwhelming that your enemies' will to fight is shattered forever. A blade can end a life. Fear can end an empire.

entries.name: Rule with an Iron Fist
entries: Once you have conquered, tolerate no dissent. Your word is law. Those who obey it shall be favored. Those who defy it shall be punished as an example to all who might follow.

entries.name: Strength Above All
entries: You shall rule until a stronger one arises. Then you must grow mightier and meet the challenge, or fall to your own ruin.

entries.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

entries.caption: Oath of Conquest Spells
rows: {@spell 艾嘉西斯之鎧}, {@spell 命令術}
{@spell 人類定身術}, {@spell 靈體武器}

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to exude a terrifying presence. As an action, you force each creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

entries.name: Aura of Conquest
entries: Starting at 7th level, you constantly emanate a menacing aura while you're not {@condition incapacitated}. The aura includes your space, extends 10 feet from you in every direction, and is blocked by total cover.

If a creature is {@condition frightened} of you, its speed is reduced to 0 while in the aura, and that creature takes psychic damage equal to half your paladin level if it starts its turn there. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

entries.name: Scornful Rebuke
entries: Starting at 15th level, those who dare to strike you are psychically punished for their audacity. Whenever a creature hits you with an attack, that creature takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 0) if you're not {@condition incapacitated}.

entries.name: Invincible Conqueror
entries: At 20th level, you gain the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As an action, you can magically become an avatar of conquest, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to all damage.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as part of that action.
Your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Oath of Treachery
entries: The Oath of Treachery is the path followed by paladins who have forsworn other oaths or who care only for their own power and survival. Commonly known as blackguards, these profane warriors are faithful only to themselves. Anyone desperate enough to follow one of these paladins does so because, while deceitful, these paladins command great power. Those who follow them without falling prey to their treachery hope to indulge in wanton violence and accumulate great treasure. Many of these paladins pay homage to demon lords, especially Grazz't and Orcus. Even the Lords of Hell are loath to ally with these champions of chaos, but sometimes Baalzebul and Glasya find a kindred spirit in a blackguard's penchant for double dealing and treachery.

entries.name: Tenets of Treachery
entries: A paladin who embraces the Oath of Treachery owes allegiance to no one. There are no tenets of this oath, for it lacks any substance. Those who are unfortunate enough to have close contact with blackguards have observed that a blackguard's overwhelming concern is power and safety, especially if both can be obtained at the expense of others.

entries.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

entries.caption: Oath of Treachery Spells
rows: {@spell 魅惑人類}, {@spell 腳底抹油}
{@spell 困惑術}, {@spell 高等隱形術}

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Conjure Duplicate
entries: As an action, you create a visual illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you. The illusion looks exactly like you; it is silent; it is your size, is insubstantial, doesn't occupy its space; and it is unaffected by attacks and damage. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but the illusion must remain within 120 feet of you.

For the duration, you can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature, given how uncanny the illusion is.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Poison Strike
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to make a weapon deadlier. As a bonus action, you touch one weapon or piece of ammunition and conjure a special poison on it. The poison lasts for 1 minute. The next time you hit a target with an attack using that weapon or ammunition, the target takes poison damage immediately after the attack. The poison damage equals {@dice 2d10} + your paladin level, or 20 + your paladin level if you had advantage on the attack roll.

entries.name: Aura of Treachery
entries: Starting at 7th level, you emanate an aura of discord, which gives you the following benefits.

entries.name: Cull the Herd
entries: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that has one or more of its allies within 5 feet of it.

entries.name: Treacherous Strike
entries: If a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll that attack against a creature of your choice that is also within 5 feet of the attacker. The ability fails and is wasted if the attacker is immune to being {@condition charmed}.
You can use this ability three times. You regain expended uses of it when you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Blackguard's Escape
entries: At 15th level, you have the ability to slip away from your foes. Immediately after you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to turn {@condition invisible} and teleport up to 60 feet to a spot you can see. You remain {@condition invisible} until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force a creature to make a saving throw. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

entries.name: Icon of Deceit
entries: At 20th level, you gain the ability to emanate feelings of treachery. As an action, you can magically become an avatar of deceit, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You are {@condition invisible}.

If a creature damages you on its turn, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to your spell save DC) or you control its next action, provided that you aren't {@condition incapacitated} when it takes the action. A creature automatically succeeds on the save if the creature is immune to being {@condition charmed}.
If you have advantage on an attack roll, you gain a bonus to its damage roll equal to your paladin level.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Oath of Redemption
entries: The Oath of Redemption sets a paladin on a difficult path, one that requires a holy warrior to use violence only as a last resort. Paladins who dedicate themselves to this oath believe that any person can be redeemed and that the path of benevolence and justice is one that anyone can walk. These paladins face evil creatures in the hope of turning them to the light, and the paladins slay them only when such a deed will clearly save other lives. Paladins who follow this path are known as redeemers.

While redeemers are idealists, they are no fools. Redeemers know that undead, demons, devils, and other supernatural threats can be inherently evil. Against such foes, the paladins bring the full wrath of their weapons and spells to bear. Yet the redeemers still pray that, one day, even creatures of wickedness will invite their own redemption.

entries.name: Tenets of Redemption
entries: The tenets of the Oath of Redemption hold a paladin to a high standard of peace and justice.

entries.name: Peace
entries: Violence is a weapon of last resort. Diplomacy and understanding are the paths to long-lasting peace.

entries.name: Innocence
entries: All people begin life in an innocent state, and it is their environment or the influence of dark forces that drives them to evil. By setting the proper example, and working to heal the wounds of a deeply flawed world, you can set anyone on a righteous path.

entries.name: Patience
entries: Change takes time. Those who have walked the path of the wicked must be given reminders to keep them honest and true. Once you have planted the seed of righteousness in a creature, you must work day after day to allow it to survive and then flourish.

entries.name: Wisdom
entries: Your heart and mind must stay clear, for eventually you will be forced to admit defeat. While every creature can be redeemed, some are so far along the path of evil that you have no choice but to end their lives for the greater good. Any such action must be carefully weighed and the consequences fully understood, but once you have made the decision, follow through with it knowing your path is just.

entries.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed.

entries.caption: Oath of Redemption Spells
rows: {@spell 人類定身術}, {@spell 衰弱射線}
{@spell 反制法術}, {@spell 催眠圖紋}
{@spell 歐提路克魔封法球}, {@spell 石膚術}
{@spell 怪物定身術}, {@spell 力牆術}

entries.name: Armor of Peace
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your commitment to peace allows you to walk into the most dangerous situations unarmored. While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield, your base AC is 16 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Warrior of Reconciliation
entries: At 3rd level, you foreswear the weapons of war in favor of simple tools. While wielding a simple weapon that deals bludgeoning damage, you gain a special benefit if you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with that weapon and decide to spare the creature's life. Instead of falling {@condition unconscious}, the creature is {@condition charmed} by you for 1 minute. During that time, the {@condition charmed} creature is peaceful and docile, refusing to move or to take actions or reactions, unless you command it to. You can't order the creature to attack, force someone to make a saving throw, or cause damage to itself or others. This {@condition charmed} effect ends early if you are {@condition incapacitated} or if you or your companions attack the creature, deal damage to it, or force it to make a saving throw. When the effect ends, the creature falls {@condition unconscious} if it still has 0 hit points.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to augment your presence with divine power. As a bonus action, you grant yourself a +5 bonus to the next Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check you make within the next minute.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Rebuke the Violent
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to rebuke those who use violence. As a reaction when an enemy within 10 feet of you deals damage with a melee attack against one creature other than you, you force that attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes radiant damage equal to the damage it just dealt. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

entries.name: Aura of the Guardian
entries: Starting at 7th level, you can shield your allies from harm at the cost of your own health. As a reaction when an ally within 10 feet of you takes damage, you instead magically take that damage. This feature doesn't transfer any other effects that might accompany the damage.

entries.name: Protective Spirit
entries: Starting at 15th level, a holy presence mends your wounds in combat. You regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d6} + half your paladin level if you end your turn in combat with fewer than half of your hit points remaining and you aren't {@condition incapacitated}.

entries.name: Emissary of Redemption
entries: At 20th level, you become an avatar of peace, which gives you two benefits:

items: You have resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures (their attacks, spells, and other effects).
Whenever a creature damages you, it takes damage equal to half the amount it dealt to you.

entries: If you attack a creature, deal damage to it, or force it to make a saving throw, neither benefit works against that creature until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: 征服之誓
entries: 征服之誓吸引著那些在戰鬥中尋求榮耀與征服的聖騎士們。對這些聖騎士而言僅僅建立秩序是不夠的，他們必須徹底粉碎混亂的勢力。有時候又被稱作暴君騎士或戰爭販子，他們集結成嚴酷的軍隊或組織，以服侍戰爭之神或哲學、以及秩序良好的力量。
其中一些這類聖騎士甚至會誤入歧途，與九獄同流合汙，重視律法規則更勝過仁慈慰藉。大惡魔巴爾，阿弗納斯地獄的軍閥，將許多這樣的聖騎士—他們被稱為地獄騎士—視為祂最忠誠的追隨者。地獄騎士用倒下的敵人身上的戰利品來裝飾他們的盔甲，做為對任何敢於反抗他們以及他們領主法令的人的可怕警告。這些騎士往往會受到其他征服之誓聖騎士的強烈抵制，他們認為地獄騎士已經在黑暗中走得太遠了。

entries.name: 征服之信條
entries: 立下征服之誓的聖騎士會將征服之信條烙印在他們的上臂。

entries.name: 熄滅希望之火
entries: 僅僅在戰鬥中擊敗敵人是不夠的。你的壓倒性勝利必須顯著到足以永遠粉碎敵人的戰鬥意志。刀劍只能結束生命，恐懼卻能終結國家。

entries.name: 以鐵腕統治
entries: 一旦你完成征服，不要容忍任何異議。你的話語就是法律。那些遵循你的人將被優待，那些反抗你的人則會受到懲罰，以儆效尤。

entries.name: 力量高於一切
entries: 你將維持統治直到更強的勢力崛起。那時你必須變得更強大以迎接挑戰，否則就會自取滅亡。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 征服之誓法術
rows: {@spell 艾嘉西斯之鎧}, {@spell 命令術}
{@spell 人類定身術}, {@spell 靈體武器}

entries.name: 引導神力：征服威儀
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力以展現出駭人的威儀。以一個動作，你強迫每個距離你30呎內你所選且你能看見的生物進行一次睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物將因你而陷入{@condition 恐懼}長達1分鐘。陷入{@condition 恐懼}的生物可以在它的每個回合結束時重複此豁免，若豁免成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。

entries.name: 引導神力：神導打擊
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力以超常準確度進行打擊。當你進行一次攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的引導神力以在該檢定中獲得+10的加值。你在看見擲骰結果之後，但DM說出攻擊是否命中之前決定是否使用此能力。

entries.name: 征服靈光
entries: 從7級開始，你將在不處於{@condition 無力}狀態時持續散發出威嚇靈光。這道靈光從你身上向各個方向延伸10呎，但並不會穿透全掩護。
若一個生物{@condition 恐懼}於你，則它的移動速度將在處於這道靈光時被歸零，且該生物將在它於該處開始它的回合時受到等同於你聖騎士等級一半的精神傷害。
在18級時，這個靈光的範圍將增加至30呎。

entries.name: 輕蔑斥喝
entries: 從15級開始，那些膽敢攻擊你的人們將因他們的放肆而遭受精神上的懲罰。每當一個生物以一次攻擊命中你時，若你並未{@condition 無力}，則該生物將受到等同於你魅力調整值（最少為1）的精神傷害。

entries.name: 無敵征服者
entries: 在20級時，你獲得駕馭卓越武藝的能力。以一個動作，你可以魔法性地變成征服的化身，在接下來1分鐘內獲得下列好處：

items: 你對所有傷害具有抗性。
當你在你的回合採取{@action 攻擊}動作時，你可以做為該動作的一部份額外再進行一次攻擊。
你的近戰武器攻擊將在{@dice d20}的結果骰出19或20時造成重擊。

entries: 一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: 救贖之誓
entries: 救贖之誓為聖騎士設立了一條艱難的道路：要求這名神聖戰士只能在最後關頭使用暴力。獻身於救贖之誓的聖騎士們相信任何人都可以得到救贖，且所有人都可以走在仁慈與正義的道路上。這些聖騎士直面邪惡的生物，希望能使他們的敵人棄暗投明。且除非這麼做很明顯能拯救其他性命，否則他們絕不會殺死自己的敵人。遵循這條道路的聖騎士們也被稱作救贖者。
儘管救贖者身為理想主義者，他們也並不是傻瓜。救贖者也明白不死生物、惡魔、魔鬼、和其他超自然威脅天性邪惡。在面對這類敵人時，立下這個誓言的聖騎士們隨時準備用武器和法術來擊垮它們。盡管如此，救贖者們仍在心底祈禱著，希望總有一天，即使是這些邪惡生物也能得到它們的救贖。

entries.name: 救贖之信條
entries: 救贖之誓的信條要求聖騎士維持著高標準的和平與正義。

entries.name: 和平
entries: 暴力是最後的手段。交流和理解才是實現長久和平的途徑。

entries.name: 無辜
entries: 所有人生來都是清白無罪的，而驅使他們走向邪惡的往往是他們周遭的環境或黑暗力量的影響。透過樹立正確的榜樣，並治癒這個殘缺世界的創傷，你可以令任何人走上正確的道路。

entries.name: 耐心
entries: 改變需要時間。那些犯下罪行的人必須被時刻提醒保持誠實與真誠。一旦你在生物心中種下正義的種子，你就必須日復一日地為其努力，以讓它得以開花結果。

entries.name: 睿智
entries: 你的心靈必須時刻保持清醒，理解你最終也許會被迫承認失敗。儘管所有生物都可以得到救贖，那有些人卻已在邪惡的路上行走的太遠，以至於你別無選擇，只能為了大義將其剿滅。任何這類行動都應當經過仔細權衡．並考慮清楚其後果，然而你一旦做出決定，就得堅持下去。

entries.name: 聖誓法術
entries: 你在下列聖騎士等級時獲得相應的聖誓法術。

entries.caption: 救贖之誓法術
rows: {@spell 安定心神}, {@spell 人類定身術}
{@spell 反制法術}, {@spell 催眠圖紋}
{@spell 歐提路克魔封法球}, {@spell 石膚術}
{@spell 怪物定身術}, {@spell 力牆術}

entries.name: 引導神力：和平使者
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力以利用神性力量增強你的威儀。以一個附贈動作，你讓自己在接下來的10分鐘內所進行的魅力（{@skill 說服}）檢定獲得+5加值。

entries.name: 引導神力：斥喝暴力
entries: 你可以使用你的引導神力以斥喝那些使用暴力的人們。緊接在一個距離你30呎內的攻擊者以一次攻擊對你以外的生物造成傷害後，你可以使用你的反應以強迫該攻擊者進行一次睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，該攻擊者將受到等同於它剛才造成傷害數值的光耀傷害。若豁免成功，則它只受到一半的傷害。

entries.name: 護衛靈光
entries: 從7級開始，你能夠以自己的健康為代價保護盟友不受傷害。當一個距離你10呎內的生物受到傷害，你可以使用你的反應以用魔法代替該生物承受該傷害。這個能力並不會轉移任何其他可能伴隨著傷害的效果，且這個傷害無法被任何方式減輕。
在18級時，這個靈光的範圍將增加至30呎。

entries.name: 守護之魂
entries: 從15級開始，神聖存在將在戰鬥中治癒你的傷勢。若你在戰鬥中以少於生命值一半的狀況結束你的回合，且不處於{@condition 無力}狀態，則你將回復等同於{@dice 1d6}+你聖騎士等級一半的生命值。

entries.name: 救贖使者
entries: 在20級時，你將成為和平的化身，並賦予你下列二個好處：

items: 你對所有其他生物所造成的傷害（它們的攻擊、法術、和其他效果）具有抗性。
每當一個生物以一次攻擊命中你，它將受到等同於你從該攻擊受到傷害的一半的光耀傷害。

entries: 若你攻擊一個生物、對它施放法術、或以任何這個能力以外的方式對它造成傷害，則直到你完成一次長休之前，這兩個好處對該生物都不會產生作用。

Clad in plate armor that gleams in the sunlight despite the dust and grime of long travel, a human lays down her sword and shield and places her hands on a mortally wounded man. Divine radiance shines from her hands, the man's wounds knit closed, and his eyes open wide with amazement.

A dwarf crouches behind an outcrop, his black cloak making him nearly invisible in the night, and watches an orc war band celebrating its recent victory. Silently, he stalks into their midst and whispers an oath, and two orcs are dead before they even realize he is there.

Silver hair shining in a shaft of light that seems to illuminate only him, an elf laughs with exultation. His spear flashes like his eyes as he jabs again and again at a twisted giant, until at last his light overcomes its hideous darkness.

Whatever their origin and their mission, paladins are united by their oaths to stand against the forces of evil. Whether sworn before a god's altar and the witness of a priest, in a sacred glade before nature spirits and fey beings, or in a moment of desperation and grief with the dead as the only witness, a paladin's oath is a powerful bond. It is a source of power that turns a devout warrior into a blessed champion.

entries.name: The Cause of Righteousness
entries: A paladin swears to uphold justice and righteousness, to stand with the good things of the world against the encroaching darkness, and to hunt the forces of evil wherever they lurk. Different paladins focus on various aspects of the cause of righteousness, but all are bound by the oaths that grant them power to do their sacred work. Although many paladins are devoted to gods of good, a paladin's power comes as much from a commitment to justice itself as it does from a god.

Paladins train for years to learn the skills of combat, mastering a variety of weapons and armor. Even so, their martial skills are secondary to the magical power they wield: power to heal the sick and injured, to smite the wicked and the undead, and to protect the innocent and those who join them in the fight for justice.

entries.name: Beyond the Mundane Life
entries: Almost by definition, the life of a paladin is an adventuring life. Unless a lasting injury has taken him or her away from adventuring for a time, every paladin lives on the front lines of the cosmic struggle against evil. Fighters are rare enough among the ranks of the militias and armies of the world, but even fewer people can claim the true calling of a paladin. When they do receive the call, these warriors turn from their former occupations and take up arms to fight evil. Sometimes their oaths lead them into the service of the crown as leaders of elite groups of knights, but even then their loyalty is first to the cause of righteousness, not to crown and country.

Adventuring paladins take their work seriously. A delve into an ancient ruin or dusty crypt can be a quest driven by a higher purpose than the acquisition of treasure. Evil lurks in dungeons and primeval forests, and even the smallest victory against it can tilt the cosmic balance away from oblivion.

entries.name: Creating a Paladin
entries: The most important aspect of a paladin character is the nature of his or her holy quest. Although the class features related to your oath don't appear until you reach 3rd level, plan ahead for that choice by reading the oath descriptions at the end of the class. Are you a devoted servant of good, loyal to the gods of justice and honor, a holy knight in shining armor venturing forth to smite evil? Are you a glorious champion of the light, cherishing everything beautiful that stands against the shadow, a knight whose oath descends from traditions older than many of the gods? Or are you an embittered loner sworn to take vengeance on those who have done great evil, sent as an angel of death by the gods or driven by your need for revenge? Appendix B lists many deities worshiped by paladins throughout the multiverse, such as Torm, Tyr, Heironeous, Paladine, Kiri-Jolith, Dol Arrah, the Silver Flame, Bahamut, Athena, Re-Horakhty, and Heimdall.

How did you experience your call to serve as a paladin? Did you hear a whisper from an unseen god or angel while you were at prayer? Did another paladin sense the potential within you and decide to train you as a squire? Or did some terrible event—the destruction of your home, perhaps—drive you to your quests? Perhaps you stumbled into a sacred grove or a hidden elven enclave and found yourself called to protect all such refuges of goodness and beauty. Or you might have known from your earliest memories that the paladin's life was your calling, almost as if you had been sent into the world with that purpose stamped on your soul.

As guardians against the forces of wickedness, paladins are rarely of any evil alignment. Most of them walk the paths of charity and justice. Consider how your alignment colors the way you pursue your holy quest and the manner in which you conduct yourself before gods and mortals. Your oath and alignment might be in harmony, or your oath might represent standards of behavior that you have not yet attained.

entries.name: Quick Build
entries: You can make a paladin quickly by following these suggestions. First, Strength should be your highest ability score, followed by Charisma. Second, choose the {@background noble} background.
The true worth of a paladin is measured not in foes defeated or dungeons plundered. It is measured in lives saved and hearts turned to the causes of mercy and justice.

A paladin is a living embodiment of an oath—a promise or a vow made manifest in the person of a holy warrior who has the skill and the determination to see the cause through to the end. Some paladins devote themselves expressly to protecting the innocent and spreading justice in the world, while others resolve to attain that goal by conquering those who stand defiant and bringing them under the rule of law.

Although no paladin in the world could be described as typical, a number of them are narrow-minded do-gooders who refuse to tolerate even the smallest deviation from their own outlook. Paladins who take up the adventuring life, however, rarely remain so rigid in their attitudes—if only to keep from alienating their companions.

You can flesh out your paladin character by using the suggestions below. It's important to keep in mind that most paladins aren't robots. They have doubts and prejudices and harbor contradictory thoughts just as any other character does. Some are compelled by an internal motivation that might sometimes be at odds with the principles of their oaths.

entries.name: Personal Goal
entries: The precepts of a paladin's oath provide purpose to the character and dictate an ultimate goal or an overall intent that the paladin abides by and advances. Aside from that, some paladins are driven by a personal goal that either complements or transcends the dictates of their oaths. Paladins who swear different oaths might have the same personal goal, differing only in how they apply that goal to their actions when upholding their oaths.
If your paladin character has a personal goal, it might be drawn from some life event and thus not directly tied to the oath.

entries.caption: Personal Goal
rows: Peace. You fight so that future generations will not have to.
Revenge. Your oath is the vehicle through which you will right an ancient wrong.
Duty. You will live up to what you have sworn to do, or die trying.
Leadership. You will win a great battle that bards will sing about, and in so doing, you will become an example to inspire others.
Faith. You know your path is righteous, or else the gods would not have set you upon it.
Glory. You will lead the world into a grand new era, one that will be branded with your name.

entries.name: Symbol
entries: Paladins are mindful of the influence of symbols, and many of them adopt or design an artistic device that bears a distinctive image. Your symbol exemplifies the oath you have taken and communicates that message to those around you, friend and foe alike.
Your symbol might be displayed on a banner, a flag, or your clothing for all to see. Or it could be less obvious, such as a trinket or a token that you carry concealed on your person.

entries.caption: Symbol
rows: A dragon, emblematic of your nobility in peace and your ferocity in combat
A clenched fist, because you are always ready to fight for your beliefs
An upraised open hand, indicating your preference for diplomacy over combat
A red heart, showing the world your commitment to justice
A black heart, signifying that emotions such as pity do not sway your dedication to your oath
An unblinking eye, meaning that you are ever alert to all threats against your cause

entries.name: Nemesis
entries: Their adherence to a sacred oath demands that paladins take an active stance in carrying their beliefs into the world. This activity naturally leads to conflict with creatures or entities that oppose those beliefs. Among those opponents, one often stands out as a paladin's most persistent or most formidable foe—a nemesis whose presence or influence is a constant factor in a paladin's life.

Your paladin character might have an enemy that dates from the days before you took up your path. Or you could be a target because when you became a paladin, you immediately attracted the attention of those that would do you in. If you have a nemesis, who or what is it? Whom among your enemies do you consider to be the biggest threat to achieving your goals?

entries.caption: Nemesis
rows: A mighty orc war chief who threatens to overrun and destroy everything you hold sacred
A fiend or a celestial, the agent of a power of the Outer Planes, who has been charged with corrupting or redeeming you, as appropriate
A dragon whose servants dog your steps
A high priest who sees you as a misguided fool and wants you to abandon your religion
A rival paladin who trained with you but became an oath-breaker and holds you responsible
A vampire who has sworn revenge against all paladins after being defeated by one

entries.name: Temptation
entries: Although paladins are dedicated to their oaths, they are mortals, and thus they are flawed. Many of them exhibit a type of behavior or hold to an attitude that is not in keeping with the highest ideals of their calling.
What is the temptation that your character succumbs to or finds it difficult to resist?

entries.caption: Temptation
rows: Fury. When your anger is roused, you have trouble thinking straight, and you fear you might do something you'll regret.
Pride. Your deeds are noteworthy, and no one takes note of them more often than you.
Lust. You can't resist an attractive face and a pleasant smile.
Envy. You are mindful of what some famous folk have accomplished, and you feel inadequate when your deeds don't compare to theirs.
Despair. You consider the great strength of the enemies you must defeat, and at times you see no way to achieve final victory.
Greed. Regardless of how much glory and treasure you amass, it's never enough for you.

default: (a)一件{@item 鱗甲|phb} 或 (b)一件{@item 皮甲|phb}
(a)二把{@item 短劍|phb} 或 (b)二把{@filter 簡易近戰武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=simple weapon;melee weapon}
(a)一套{@item 地城探險家套裝|phb} 或 (b)一套{@item 探索者套裝|phb}
一把{@item 長弓|phb}和一個裝有{@item 箭(20)|phb|20支箭}的{@item 箭袋|phb}

classFeatures.name: 宿敵
entries: 從1級開始，你在對一個特定類型的敵人的研究、追跡、狩獵、和甚至交談上已相當具備充足的經驗。

選擇一個宿敵類型：{@filter 異怪|bestiary|type=aberration}、{@filter 野獸|bestiary|type=beast}、{@filter 天界生物|bestiary|type=celestial}、{@filter 構裝體|bestiary|type=construct}、{@filter 龍|bestiary|type=dragon}、{@filter 元素|bestiary|type=elemental}、{@filter 精類|bestiary|type=fey}、{@filter 邪魔|bestiary|type=fiend}、{@filter 巨人|bestiary|type=giant}、{@filter 怪獸|bestiary|type=monstrosity}、{@filter 泥怪|bestiary|type=ooze}、{@filter 植物|bestiary|type=plant}、或{@filter 不死生物|bestiary|type=undead}。或者，你可以選擇二個{@filter 類人生物|bestiary|type=humanoid}種族（像是{@creature 豺狼人|mm}和{@creature 獸人|mm}）做為宿敵。
你在用於追蹤你宿敵的睿知（{@skill 求生}）檢定、以及用以回憶關於它們情報的智力檢定中具有優勢。
當你獲得此能力時，若你的宿敵擁有至少一種語言，你也選擇學會一種被它們所使用的語言。
你在6級和14級時選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。隨著你提升等級，你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。

classFeatures.name: 自然探索者
entries: 你特別熟悉於一種自然環境，且熟稔在這類區域中旅行和生存的方式。選擇一種偏好環境：極地、海岸、沙漠、森林、草地、高山、沼澤、或幽暗地域。當你進行一次關聯於你偏好環境的智力或睿知檢定時，若你使用一個你所熟練的技能，則你的熟練加值變為二倍。
當在你的偏好環境中旅行長達1個小時或更久，你將獲得下列好處：

items: 困難地形不會減慢你們團隊的旅行速度。
除非是因為魔法的緣故，否則你們團隊不會迷路。
即使你在旅行途中正從事於其他行動（像是覓食、導航、或追跡），你仍保持對危險的警戒。
若你正獨自旅行，你能夠以正常步調隱匿移動。
當你覓食時，你能找到二倍你原本所能找到的食物。
當你追跡其他生物時，你也能得知它們確切的數量、它們的體型、以及它們在多久之前經過這片區域。

entries: 你在6級和10級時選擇一種額外的偏好環境。

classFeatures.name: 戰鬥風格
entries: 在2級時，你採用一種特殊的戰鬥風格以做為你的專業。從下列選項中選擇一種。你不能獲得相同的戰鬥風格選項超過一次，即使你有機會再選擇它也一樣。

entries.name: 弓道
entries: 你在使用遠程武器進行的攻擊檢定中獲得+2加值。

entries.name: 近身射手
entries: 當你在距離一個敵意生物5呎以內時進行一次遠程攻擊，你在該攻擊檢定中並不會具有劣勢。你的遠程攻擊忽略距離你30呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊的攻擊檢定中獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 防禦
entries: 當你穿戴護甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 決鬥
entries: 當你單手持用一把近戰武器，且沒有持用其他武器時，你在使用該武器所進行的傷害骰中獲得+2加值。

entries.name: 水手
entries: 只要你未穿戴重甲或使用盾牌，你就擁有等同於你正常移動速度的游泳速度和攀爬速度，且你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 坑道鬥士
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以進入防禦架式並持續直到你的下個回合開始。當你處於防禦架式時，你可以進行藉機攻擊而無需使用你的反應，且你可以處於你觸及範圍內的生物移動超過5呎時使用你的反應對它進行一次近戰攻擊。

entries.name: 雙武器戰鬥
entries: 當你進行雙武器戰鬥時，你可以將你的屬性調整值加入第二次攻擊的傷害中。

classFeatures.name: 施法
entries: 在你升至2級時，你學會如同德魯伊的方式使用大自然的精粹以施放法術。請參閱{@book 第十章|PHB|10}以了解關於施法的規則，以及第十一章以查閱{@filter 遊俠法術列表|spells|class=ranger}。

entries.name: 法術位
entries: 遊俠表中顯示了你有多少個法術位可以用來施放你一環或更高環的{@filter 遊俠法術|spells|class=ranger}。要施放其中一個法術，你必須消耗一個與該法術環階相同或更高的法術位。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的法術位。
舉例來說，如果你知曉一個1環的{@spell 化獸為友}法術，且你擁有一個1環和一個2環的法術位，則你可以使用其中任意一個法術位來施放{@spell 化獸為友}。

entries.name: 一環或更高環的已知法術
entries: 你知曉二個從遊俠法術列表中自選的1環法術。
遊俠表中的已知法術欄位顯示你將在何時學習到更多自選的遊俠法術。每個這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。舉例來說，當你在此職業升至5級時，你可以學習一個新的1環或2環法術。
此外，當你提升這個職業的等級時，你可以從遊俠的法術列表中挑選一個法術來取代一個你目前已知的法術，而它的環階也必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。

entries.name: 施法屬性
entries: 由於你的魔法是源自你與大自然的協調，睿知是你施展遊俠法術的施法屬性。每當法術提及你的施法屬性時，你將使用你的睿知。此外，當決定你遊俠法術的豁免DC、以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你使用你的睿知調整值。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠範型
entries: 在3級時，你從可選範型列表中選擇一種你致力於達成的範型。你的選擇將在3級、7級、11級、和15級時賦予你新的能力。

classFeatures.name: 原初意識
entries: 從3級開始，你可以使用你的動作並消耗一個遊俠法術位以集中你的意識於你周遭的區域。在為你所消耗法術位的每環階1分鐘內，你可以感知下列類型的生物是否存在於距離你1哩內的區域：異怪、天界生物、龍、元素、精類、邪魔、和不死生物。此能力無法揭露出該生物的位置和數量。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至4級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 額外攻擊
entries: 從5級開始，每當你在你的回合採取{@action 攻擊}動作，你可以攻擊二次，而非一次。

classFeatures.name: 宿敵和自然探索者強化
classFeatures.ENG_name: Favored Enemy and Natural Explorer improvements
entries: 在6級時，你獲得一種額外的偏好環境。
在6級時，你選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠範型能力
entries: 在7級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至8級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 大地行者
entries: 從8級開始，移動穿過非魔法的困難地形並不會花費你額外的移動速度。你也可以穿越非魔法植物而不會被它們減緩速度，若它們是荊棘、棘刺、或其他類似危險，你也不會被它們的傷害。
此外，在對抗由魔法創造或控制的植物所造成的阻礙移動效果時（像是{@spell 糾纏術}法術創造出的植物），你所進行的豁免檢定具有優勢。

classFeatures.name: 避人耳目
entries: 從10級開始，你可以花費1分鐘的時間為自己創造一個偽裝。你必須要能取用新鮮的泥巴、土壤、植物、煙灰、和其他自然產出的材料以創造你的偽裝。
一旦你透過這個方式偽裝，你可以透過將自己貼合於一個高度和寬度至少與你一樣大的固體表面上，例如樹木或牆壁，以嘗試進行躲藏。只要你待於該處且不移動或採取動作，你就在敏捷（{@skill 隱匿}）檢定中獲得+10的加值。一旦你移動或採取動作或反應，你就必須再次偽裝自己以獲得這個好處。

classFeatures.name: 自然探索者強化
entries: 在10級時，你獲得一種額外的偏好環境。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠範型能力
entries: 在11級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至12級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 無蹤步
entries: 從14級開始，你可以在你的回合以一個附贈動作採取{@action 躲藏}動作。同時，你不會被非魔法的手段追蹤，除非你選擇留下蹤跡。

classFeatures.name: 宿敵強化
entries: 在14級時，你選擇一種額外的宿敵以及一種關聯語言。你的選擇必須反映你在你冒險中所遭遇過的怪物類型。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠範型能力
entries: 在15級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠範型所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至16級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 野性感官
entries: 在18級時，你獲得超自然的感官以幫助你對抗看不見的生物。當你攻擊一個你看不見的生物時，你並不會因為無法看見它而在你對它進行的攻擊檢定中承受劣勢。同時，只要該生物沒有躲藏於你，且你不處於{@condition 目盲}或{@condition 耳聾}狀態，則你也能察覺到任何距離你30呎內{@condition 隱形}生物的位置。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至19級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 眾敵屠戮
entries: 在20級時，你成為了一名針對你敵人的無雙獵手。在你的每個回合一次，你可以將你的睿知調整值加到你對你其中一個宿敵所進行的攻擊檢定或傷害骰中。你可以選擇在擲骰之前或之後使用此能力，但是必須在任何擲骰效果適用之前使用。

subclassFeatures.name: 獵人
entries: 仿效獵人範型意味著接受你做為文明和荒野恐懼間壁壘的身分。隨著你行走在獵人的道途上，你學會對抗迎面而來威脅的專業技巧，從狂暴的食人魔、成群的獸人、到巨人和恐怖的龍族們。

entries.name: 狩者獵物
entries: 在3級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：巨怪獵者、巨人殺手、或滅族者。

entries.name: 巨怪獵者
entries: 你的執著可以毀滅最強大的敵人。當你以一次武器攻擊命中一個生物，若它的生命值低於最大值，則該生物將受到額外的{@dice 1d8}傷害。你每回合只能造成一次這個額外傷害。

entries.name: 巨人殺手
entries: 當一個距離你5呎內，體型為大型或更大的生物對你進行的一次攻擊命中或失手時，只要你可以看見該生物，你就可以使用你的反應以立刻在它的攻擊之後對它進行攻擊。

entries.name: 滅族者
entries: 在你的每個回合一次，當你進行一次武器攻擊時，你可以使用相同的武器對一個距離原本目標5呎內，且處於你武器射程內的另一個生物進行另一次攻擊。

entries.name: 防禦性戰術
entries: 在7級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：逃離眾敵、防禦多重攻擊、或鋼鐵意志。

entries.name: 逃離眾敵
entries: 所有對你進行的藉機攻擊將具有劣勢。

entries.name: 防禦多重攻擊
entries: 當一個生物以一次攻擊命中你時，你的AC將對該生物在該回合中所進行的所有後續攻擊獲得+4的加值。

entries.name: 鋼鐵意志
entries: 你在對抗{@condition 恐懼}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

entries.name: 多重攻擊
entries: 在11級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：箭雨、或劍刃風暴。

entries.name: 箭雨
entries: 你可以使用你的動作以進行一次遠程攻擊，並以處於你武器射程內你所能看見一點的周圍10呎範圍內的任意數量個生物做為目標。你必須有足夠的彈藥以攻擊每個目標，且你為每個目標進行各自的攻擊檢定。

entries.name: 劍刃風暴
entries: 你可以使用你的動作以進行一次近戰攻擊，並以距離你5呎內的任意數量個生物做為目標，為每個目標進行各自的攻擊檢定。

entries.name: 卓越獵人防禦
entries: 在15級時，你獲得下列其中一個你所選擇的能力：反射閃避、逆潮而立、或直覺閃避。

entries.name: 反射閃避
entries: 你可以靈活地躲開某些範圍效果，像是紅龍的火焰吐息、或{@spell 閃電束}法術。當你成為一個允許你進行敏捷豁免以僅承受一半傷害的效果的目標時，你改為在豁免成功時不受任何傷害，且在豁免失敗時僅承受一半傷害。

entries.name: 逆潮而立
entries: 當一個敵對生物對你進行的一次近戰攻擊失手，你可以使用你的反應以強迫該生物對你所選擇的另一個生物（除了它自己以外）重複進行一次該攻擊。

entries.name: 直覺閃避
entries: 當一個你所能看見的攻擊者使用一次攻擊命中你，你可以使用你的反應以減半該次攻擊對你的傷害。

subclassFeatures.name: 獸王
entries: 獸王範型體現了文明種族和自然野獸之間的情誼。團結一致，野獸和游俠將共同對抗威脅著文明和自然世界的可怕敵人。仿效獸王範型意味著將自己奉獻給這個理念，與動物做為同伴和朋友一同奮鬥。

entries.name: 遊俠動物夥伴
entries: 在3級時，你獲得一個動物夥伴，牠將陪伴你一起冒險，並受過訓練以與你一起戰鬥。選擇一個{@filter 體型不超過中型，且挑戰等級為1/4或更低的野獸|bestiary|challenge rating=0;1/8;1/4|type=beast|size=f;d;t;s;m|miscellaneous=!swarm}。將你的熟練加值加入該野獸的AC、攻擊檢定、傷害骰，以及任何牠所熟練的豁免檢定和技能中。牠的生命值最大值等同於牠正常的生命值最大值或你遊俠等級的四倍，兩者取高。

該野獸將盡其所能的服從你的命令。牠會在你的先攻順序採取牠的行動。在你的回合，你可以口頭命令該野獸移動到某處（你不需要花費動作）。你也可以使用你的動作以口頭命令牠採取{@action 攻擊}、{@action 疾走}、{@action 撤離}、{@action 閃避}、或{@action 協助}動作。如果你沒有命令，牠將採取{@action 閃避}動作。一旦你獲得額外攻擊能力，則當你命令該野獸採取{@action 攻擊}動作時，你可以自己進行一次武器攻擊。
若你處於{@condition 無力}狀態或不在現場，你的動物夥伴將會自主行動，專注於保護你或牠自己。牠使用牠的反應時不需要你的命令，例如進行一次藉機攻擊。
跟其他生物一樣，野獸可以在短休期間消耗生命骰。
當你只和該野獸一起在你的偏好環境中旅行時，你們能夠以正常步調隱匿移動。
若該野獸死亡，你可以藉由花費8小時的時間以用魔法與另一個對你不具有敵意的野獸建立連結以再次獲得動物夥伴。該野獸可以是與之前那隻相同或不同類型的野獸。

entries.name: 超絕訓練
entries: 從7級開始，在你的任何回合，只要你的動物夥伴沒有攻擊，你就可以使用一個附贈動作以命令該野獸在它的回合採取{@action 疾走}、{@action 撤離}、或{@action 協助}動作。此外，該野獸的攻擊現在起將在克服對非魔法攻擊和傷害的抗性和免疫能力時被視作魔法攻擊。

entries.name: 野性狂怒
entries: 從11級開始，當你命令你的動物夥伴採取{@action 攻擊}動作時，該野獸可以進行二次攻擊，或採取牠擁有的多重攻擊動作。

entries.name: 法術共享
entries: 從15級開始，當你施放以你自己為目標的法術時，若你的動物夥伴距離你30呎內，你也可以讓它受到該法術的影響。

subclassFeatures.name: Deep Stalker
entries: Many Deep Stalkers are elves, as those folk know all too well the threat posed by the drow. Deep Stalkers scout for new passages into the Underdark, carefully mapping them and working to ensure they remain watched at all times. They venture into the depths on long, dangerous patrols, disappearing for months at a time. Many of them never return. Deep Stalkers master spells useful in navigating the Underdark, and their combat tactics focus on ambush, surprise, and stealth. They fight alone or in small groups in hostile territory, relying on clever tactics to carry the day.

entries.name: Deep Stalker Magic
entries: From 3rd level, you have darkvision with a range of 90 feet. You also gain access to additional spells at 3rd, 5th, 9th, 13th, and 15th level. You are always able to cast these spells, and they do not count against your number of ranger spells known.

entries.name: Underdark Scout
entries: At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. On your first turn during combat, you gain a +10 bonus to your speed. If you use the attack action on that turn, you can make one additional attack. You gain an additional benefit on all turns after your first turn. At the end of each such turn, you can attempt to hide as a bonus action if you meet the normal requirements for hiding.

entries.name: Iron Mind
entries: At 7th level, you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

entries.name: Stalker's Flurry
entries: Starting at 11th level, you have the ability to ensure that your attacks count. If you miss with an attack during your turn, you can immediately make an additional attack. You can gain one additional attack during your turn with this ability.

entries.name: Stalker's Dodge
entries: At 15th level, you master the ability to disrupt an opponent's attacks. If a creature attacks you and does not have advantage on the attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant it disadvantage on the attack roll. You must use this ability before you know the result of the attack.

subclassFeatures.name: Horizon Walker
entries: Rangers of the Horizon Conclave guard the world against threats that originate from other planes. They seek out planar portals and keep watch over them, venturing to the outer and inner planes as needed to defeat threats.

entries.name: Planar Magic
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Horizon Walker Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, and it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

entries.name: Planar Warrior
entries: At 3rd level, you learn to draw on the energy of the planes to augment your attacks.

As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Until the end of this turn, your attacks against that creature ignore its damage resistances, and the next time you hit it on this turn, it takes an additional {@dice 1d6} force damage.

entries.name: Portal Lore
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to detect the presence of planar portals. As an action, you detect the distance and direction to any planar portals within 1,000 feet of you. You also sense which plane of existence each portal leads to. However, if magic obscures any details of a portal, this feature doesn't reveal them.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. Alternatively, you can use the feature again if you expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher.
See the "Planar Travel" section in chapter 2 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for examples of planar portals.

entries.name: Ethereal Step
entries: At 7th level, you learn to step through the Ethereal Plane. As a bonus action on your turn, you can cast the {@spell etherealness} spell with this feature, but the spell ends at the end of the current turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Distant Strike
entries: At 11th level, you gain the ability to step between the planes in a blink of an eye. When you use the {@action Attack} action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack. You must be able to see the destination of the teleportation.
If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack with it against a third creature.

entries.name: Spectral Defense
entries: At 15th level, your ability to move between planes becomes even more finely tuned. As a reaction when you take damage, you can halve that damage against you. For a moment, you slip into the planar boundary to lessen the harm.

subclassFeatures.name: Primeval Guardian
entries: Rangers of the Primeval Guardian Conclave follow an ancient tradition rooted in powerful druidic magic. These rangers learn to become one with nature, allowing them to channel the aspects of various beasts and plants in order to overcome their foes.

These rangers dwell in the elder forests of the world. They venture out only rarely, as they consider it their sacred duty to protect the druidic groves and ancient trees that saw the earliest days of the world.

entries.name: Guardian Magic
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Primeval Guardian Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, and it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

entries.name: Guardian Soul
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you gain the ability to temporarily grow and take on the appearance of a treelike person, covered with leaves and bark. As a bonus action, you assume this guardian form, which lasts until you end it as a bonus action or until you are {@condition incapacitated}.
You undergo the following changes while in your guardian form:

items: Your size becomes Large, unless you were larger.
Any speed you have becomes 5 feet, unless the speed was lower.
Your reach increases by 5 feet.
You gain a number of temporary hit points at the start of each of your turns. The number equals half your ranger level. When the form ends, you lose any temporary hit points you have from it.

entries.name: Piercing Thorns
entries: At 3rd level, your command of primal magic allows you to enhance your attacks with thorns. Once during each of your turns, you can deal an additional {@dice 1d6} piercing damage to one creature you hit with a weapon attack.

entries.name: Ancient Fortitude
entries: At 7th level, you gain the endurance of the ancient forests. Your hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 2 per ranger level when you assume your guardian form. This increase lasts until you leave the form; your hit point maximum then returns to normal, but your current hit points remain the same, unless they must decrease to abide by your hit point maximum.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Rooted Defense
entries: At 11th level, you gain the ability to twist and turn the ground beneath you. While you are in your guardian form, the ground within 30 feet of you is difficult terrain for your enemies.

entries.name: Guardian Aura
entries: Starting at 15th level, your guardian form emanates a magical aura that fortifies your injured allies. When any ally starts their turn within 30 feet of your guardian form, that ally regains a number of hit points equal to half your ranger level. This aura has no effect on a creature that has half or more of its hit points, and it has no effect on undead and constructs.

subclassFeatures.name: Monster Slayer
entries: Rangers of the Slayer Conclave seek out vampires, dragons, evil fey, fiends, and other powerful magical threats. Trained in a variety of arcane and divine techniques to overcome such monsters, slayers are experts at unearthing and defeating mighty foes.

entries.name: Slayer's Mysticism
entries: You learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Slayer Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you but doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

entries.name: Slayer's Eye
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you gain the ability to study and unravel a creature's defenses. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you. You immediately learn the target's vulnerabilities, immunities, and resistances. You also learn any special effects triggered when the target takes damage, such as fire damage halting its regeneration.
In addition, the first time each turn you hit the target with a weapon attack, the target takes an extra {@dice 1d6} damage from the weapon.
This benefit lasts until you target a different creature with this feature or until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Supernatural Defense
entries: At 7th level, you gain extra resilience against your prey's assaults on your mind and body. Whenever the target of your Slayer's Eye forces you to make a saving throw, add {@dice 1d6} to your roll.

entries.name: Relentless Slayer
entries: At 11th level, you gain the ability to foil your foe's ability to escape. Your study of folklore and arcane knowledge gives you a key insight to keep your prey cornered. If the target of your Slayer's Eye attempts to teleport, change its shape, travel to another plane of existence, or turn gaseous, you can use your reaction to make a Wisdom check contested by a Wisdom check made by the target. To use this ability, you must be able to see the target and need to be within 30 feet of it. If you succeed, you foil its attempt, causing it to waste the action, bonus action, or reaction it used.

entries.name: Slayer's Counter
entries: At 15th level, you gain the ability to counterattack when your prey tries to sabotage you. If the target of your Slayer's Eye forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against it. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If the attack hits, your save automatically succeeds, in addition to the attack's normal effects.

subclassFeatures.name: 幽域追蹤者
entries: 幽域追蹤者居身於那些最黑暗的場所：地表深處、暗巷之間、太古叢林、和其他任何籠罩在昏暗微光的地方。大部分人們在進入這種場所時都會驚恐不安，但幽域追蹤者們卻能大膽於黑暗中冒險，試圖在威脅來到廣闊世界之前伏擊它們。這類遊俠經常出沒於幽暗地域，但是他們也會前往任何邪惡勢力蟄伏的所在。

entries.name: 幽域追蹤者魔法
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如幽域追蹤者法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

entries.name: 懼怖伏兵
entries: 在3級時，你精通於伏擊的藝術。你可以讓你先攻檢定獲得等同於你睿知調整值的加值。
在每個戰鬥的你的第一個回合開始時，你的步行速度增加10呎，持續直到該回合結束。若你在該回合採取{@action 攻擊}動作，做為該動作的一部份，你可以進行一次額外的武器攻擊。若該攻擊命中，則目標將受到額外{@dice 1d8}該武器傷害類型的傷害。

entries.name: 幽影視覺
entries: 在3級時，你獲得60呎範圍的黑暗視覺。若你已經擁有來自你種族的黑暗視覺，則它的範圍將增加30呎。
你也擅長於避開依賴於黑暗視覺的生物。當處於黑暗環境時，你對任何嘗試依靠黑暗視覺以看見黑暗中的你的生物而言處於{@condition 隱形}狀態。

entries.name: 鋼鐵心智
entries: 從7級起，你已磨練出用於抵抗來自於你獵物的精神影響力量的能力。你獲得睿知豁免的熟練。若你已經擁有此熟練，則你可以改為獲得智力豁免或魅力豁免的熟練（由你選擇）。

entries.name: 追獵如風
entries: 在11級時，你學會以出人意料的高速進行攻擊，以讓你將一次失手轉變成另一次打擊。在你的每個回合一次，當你的一次武器攻擊失手時，你可以進行另一次武器攻擊以做為同個動作的一部份。

entries.name: 暗影閃避
entries: 從15級開始，隨著一縷環繞在你身邊的超自然陰影，你能夠以令人無法預料的方式閃躲。當一個生物對你進行一次攻擊檢定且該檢定不具有優勢，你可以使用你的反應以讓它承受劣勢。你必須在你知道該攻擊檢定的結果之前決定是否使用此能力。

subclassFeatures.name: 境界行者
entries: 境界行者守護著世界不受來自其他位面、或試圖以異界魔法摧毀凡界的威脅所侵害。他們尋找並看守著位面傳送門，為了追捕他們的敵人而冒險穿梭於內層位面和外層位面。這些遊俠也是多元宇宙中任何致力於守護位面中生靈和秩序的勢力的盟友—尤其是那些善良龍族、精類、和元素生物。

entries.name: 境界行者魔法
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如境界行者法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

entries.name: 偵測傳送門
entries: 在3級時，你獲得以魔法感知位面傳送門存在的能力。以一個動作，你偵測出距離你1哩內最近的位面傳送門的距離以及方位。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。
參見《地下城主指南》第二章的「位面旅行」章節以查看關於位面傳送門的例子。

entries.name: 位面戰士
entries: 在3級時，你學會汲取多元宇宙中的能量以增強你的攻擊。
以一個附贈動作，選擇一個距離你30呎內且你所能看見的生物。下一次你在該回合以一次武器攻擊命中該生物時，該攻擊所造成的所有傷害都將變成力場傷害，且該生物將受到來自該攻擊的額外{@dice 1d8}力場傷害。當你在本職業升至11級時，這個額外傷害將增加至{@dice 2d8}。

entries.name: 靈界漫步
entries: 在7級時，你學會跨入乙太位面。以一個附贈動作，你能夠以此能力施放{@spell 跨入乙太界}法術，無須消耗法術位。但此法術將在當回合結束時結束。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 閃現打擊
entries: 在11級時，你獲得在眨眼間穿梭於位面間的能力。當你採取{@action 攻擊}動作時，你可以在每次攻擊之前傳送最多10呎距離到一處你所能看見的未被佔據空間。
若你以該動作攻擊了至少二個不同的生物，你可以再額外對第三個生物進行一次攻擊。

entries.name: 虛體防禦
entries: 在15級時，你穿梭在位面之間的能力讓你得以溜進位面邊界以減輕你在戰鬥中所受到的傷害。當你受到來自於一次攻擊的傷害時，你可以使用你的反應以讓你自己獲得所有對這回合該攻擊傷害的抗性。

subclassFeatures.name: 怪物殺手
entries: 你致力於獵殺那些黑夜中的怪物和邪惡魔法的施行者。一名怪物殺手尋覓著吸血鬼、龍、邪惡精類、邪魔、以及其他魔法威脅。受過用以戰勝這類怪物的超自然技術訓練，怪物殺手精通於找出並擊敗那些強大且神秘的敵人。

entries.name: 怪物殺手魔法
entries: 從3級開始，當你在本職業升至特定等級，你將學會額外的法術，如怪物殺手法術表所示。這些法術對你而言視作遊俠法術，但並不會計入你已知遊俠法術的數量中。

entries.name: 獵人感知
entries: 在3級時，你獲得凝視一個生物並以魔法知悉傷害它最佳的方式的能力。以一個動作，選擇一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物。你將立刻知道該生物是否擁有任何傷害免疫、抗性、或是易傷，以及它們的種類。若該生物不受預言系魔法影響，則你感知到的結果將會是它不具有任何傷害免疫、抗性、和易傷。
你可以使用此能力的次數等同於你的睿知調整值（最少一次）。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的次數。

entries.name: 殺手獵物
entries: 從3級開始，你可以專注你的憤怒於單一敵人，增加你對它所造成的傷害。以一個附贈動作，你指定一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物做為此能力的目標。每個回合當你第一次以武器攻擊命中目標時，它將額外受到來自該武器的{@dice 1d6}傷害。
這個好處將持續直到你完成一次短休或長休，或在你指定另一個不同生物做為目標時提早結束。

entries.name: 超常防禦
entries: 在7級時，你獲得額外的韌性以抵抗你獵物對你身體和精神所做出的侵襲。每當你殺手獵物所指定的目標強迫你進行一次豁免檢定，或每當你進行一次屬性檢定以嘗試脫離該目標的擒抱，骰{@dice 1d6}並將其加入你的擲骰結果中。

entries.name: 魔法剋星
entries: 在11級時，你獲得阻撓其他人魔法的能力。當你看見一個距離你60呎內的生物施放法術或傳送，你可以使用你的反應以嘗試以魔法挫敗它。該生物必須成功通過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的睿知豁免，否則它的法術或傳送將失敗並被浪費。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 殺手反制
entries: 在15級時，你獲得在你的獵物嘗試妨害你時展開反擊的能力。若你殺手獵物所指定的目標強迫你進行一次豁免檢定，你可以使用你的反應以對該獵物進行一次武器攻擊。你在進行該豁免檢定之前立刻進行此攻擊。若你的攻擊命中，則除了該攻擊原本的效果之外，你的豁免檢定也將自動成功。

Rough and wild looking, a human stalks alone through the shadows of trees, hunting the orcs he knows are planning a raid on a nearby farm. Clutching a shortsword in each hand, he becomes a whirlwind of steel, cutting down one enemy after another.

After tumbling away from a cone of freezing air, an elf finds her feet and draws back her bow to loose an arrow at the white dragon. Shrugging off the wave of fear that emanates from the dragon like the cold of its breath, she sends one arrow after another to find the gaps between the dragon's thick scales.

Holding his hand high, a half-elf whistles to the hawk that circles high above him, calling the bird back to his side. Whispering instructions in Elvish, he points to the owlbear he's been tracking and sends the hawk to distract the creature while he readies his bow.

Far from the bustle of cities and towns, past the hedges that shelter the most distant farms from the terrors of the wild, amid the dense-packed trees of trackless forests and across wide and empty plains, rangers keep their unending watch.

entries.name: Deadly Hunters
entries: Warriors of the wilderness, rangers specialize in hunting the monsters that threaten the edges of civilization—humanoid raiders, rampaging beasts and monstrosities, terrible giants, and deadly dragons. They learn to track their quarry as a predator does, moving stealthily through the wilds and hiding themselves in brush and rubble. Rangers focus their combat training on techniques that are particularly useful against their specific favored foes.

Thanks to their familiarity with the wilds, rangers acquire the ability to cast spells that harness nature's power, much as a druid does. Their spells, like their combat abilities, emphasize speed, stealth, and the hunt. A ranger's talents and abilities are honed with deadly focus on the grim task of protecting the borderlands.

entries.name: Independent Adventurers
entries: Though a ranger might make a living as a hunter, a guide, or a tracker, a ranger's true calling is to defend the outskirts of civilization from the ravages of monsters and humanoid hordes that press in from the wild. In some places, rangers gather in secretive orders or join forces with druidic circles. Many rangers, though, are independent almost to a fault, knowing that, when a dragon or a band of orcs attacks, a ranger might be the first—and possibly the last—line of defense.

This fierce independence makes rangers well suited to adventuring, since they are accustomed to life far from the comforts of a dry bed and a hot bath. Faced with city-bred adventurers who grouse and whine about the hardships of the wild, rangers respond with some mixture of amusement, frustration, and compassion. But they quickly learn that other adventurers who can carry their own weight in a fight against civilization's foes are worth any extra burden. Coddled city folk might not know how to feed themselves or find fresh water in the wild, but they make up for it in other ways.

entries.name: Creating a Ranger
entries: As you create your ranger character, consider the nature of the training that gave you your particular capabilities. Did you train with a single mentor, wandering the wilds together until you mastered the ranger's ways? Did you leave your apprenticeship, or was your mentor slain—perhaps by the same kind of monster that became your favored enemy? Or perhaps you learned your skills as part of a band of rangers affiliated with a druidic circle, trained in mystic paths as well as wilderness lore. You might be self-taught, a recluse who learned combat skills, tracking, and even a magical connection to nature through the necessity of surviving in the wilds.

What's the source of your particular hatred of a certain kind of enemy? Did a monster kill someone you loved or destroy your home village? Or did you see too much of the destruction these monsters cause and commit yourself to reining in their depredations? Is your adventuring career a continuation of your work in protecting the borderlands, or a significant change? What made you join up with a band of adventurers? Do you find it challenging to teach new allies the ways of the wild, or do you welcome the relief from solitude that they offer?

entries.name: Quick Build
entries: You can make a ranger quickly by following these suggestions. First, make Dexterity your highest ability score, followed by Wisdom. (Some rangers who focus on two-weapon fighting make Strength higher than Dexterity.) Second, choose the {@background outlander} background.

I spend a lot of my life away from civilization, keeping to its fringes to protect it. Don't assume that because I don't bend the knee to your king that I haven't done more to protect him than all his knights put together.

Rangers are free-minded wanderers and seekers who patrol the edges of civilized territory, turning back the denizens of the wild lands beyond. It is a thankless job, since their efforts are rarely understood and almost never rewarded. Yet rangers persist in their duties, never doubting that their work makes the world a safer place.

A relationship with civilization informs every ranger's personality and history. Some rangers see themselves as enforcers of the law and bringers of justice on civilization's frontier, answering to no sovereign power. Others are survivalists who eschew civilization altogether. They vanquish monsters to keep themselves safe while they live in and travel through the perilous wild areas of the world. If their efforts also benefit the kingdoms and other civilized realms that they avoid, so be it.
If you're creating or playing a ranger character, the following sections offer ideas for embellishing the character and enhancing your roleplaying experience.

entries.name: View of the World
entries: A ranger's view of the world begins (and sometimes ends) with that character's outlook toward civilized folk and the places they occupy. Some rangers have an attitude toward civilization that's deeply rooted in disdain, while others pity the people they have sworn to protect—though on the battlefield, it's impossible to tell the difference between one ranger and another. Indeed, to those who have seen them operate and been the beneficiaries of their prowess, it scarcely matters why rangers do what they do. That said, no two rangers are likely to express their opinions on any matter in the same way.

If you haven't yet thought about the details of your character's worldview, consider putting a finer point on things by summarizing that viewpoint in a short statement (such as the entries on the following table). How might that feeling affect the way you conduct yourself?

entries.caption: View of the World
rows: Towns and cities are the best places for those who can't survive on their own.
The advancement of civilization is the best way to thwart chaos, but its reach must be monitored.
Towns and cities are a necessary evil, but once the wilderness is purged of supernatural threats, we will need them no more.
Walls are for cowards, who huddle behind them while others do the work of making the world safe.
Visiting a town is not unpleasant, but after a few days I feel the irresistible call to return to the wild.
Cities breed weakness by isolating folk from the harsh lessons of the wild.

entries.name: Homelands
entries: All rangers, regardless of how they came to take up the profession, have a strong connection to the natural world and its various terrains. For some rangers, the wilderness is where they grew up, either as a result of being born there or moving there at a young age. For other rangers, civilization was originally home, but the wilderness became a second homeland.

Think of your character's backstory and decide what terrain feels most like home, whether or not you were born there. What does that terrain say about your personality? Does it influence which spells you choose to learn? Have your experiences there shaped who your favored enemies are?

entries.caption: Homelands
rows: You patrolled an ancient forest, darkened and corrupted by several crossings to the Shadowfell.
As part of a group of nomads, you acquired the skills for surviving in the desert.
Your early life in the Underdark prepared you for the challenges of combating its denizens.
You dwelled on the edge of a swamp, in an area imperiled by land creatures as well as aquatic ones.
Because you grew up among the peaks, finding the best path through the mountains is second nature to you.
You wandered the far north, learning how to protect yourself and prosper in a realm overrun by ice.

entries.name: Sworn Enemy
entries: Every ranger begins with a favored enemy (or two). The determination of a favored enemy might be tied to a specific event in the character's early life, or it might be entirely a matter of choice.
What spurred your character to select a particular enemy? Was the choice made because of tradition or curiosity, or do you have a grudge to settle?

entries.caption: Sworn Enemies
rows: You seek revenge on nature's behalf for the great transgressions your foe has committed.
Your forebears or predecessors fought these creatures, and so shall you.
You bear no enmity toward your foe. You stalk such creatures as a hunter tracks down a wild animal.
You find your foe fascinating, and you collect books of tales and history concerning it.
You collect tokens of your fallen enemies to remind you of each kill.
You respect your chosen enemy, and you see your battles as a test of respective skills.

(a)二把{@item 短劍|phb} 或 (b)二把{@filter 簡易近戰武器|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=simple weapon;melee weapon}

classFeatures.name: 宿敵
entries: 從1級開始，你在對荒野中經常遭遇到的一個特定類型敵人的研究、追跡、狩獵、和甚至交談上已相當具備充足的經驗。

選擇一個宿敵類型：{@filter 野獸|bestiary|type=beast}、{@filter 精類|bestiary|type=fey}、{@filter 類人生物|bestiary|type=humanoid}、{@filter 怪獸|bestiary|type=monstrosity}、或{@filter 不死生物|bestiary|type=undead}。你對所選類型的生物所進行的武器攻擊的傷害骰獲得+2加值。此外，你在用於追蹤你宿敵的睿知（{@skill 求生}）檢定、以及用以回憶關於它們情報的智力檢定中具有優勢。
當你獲得此能力時，你同時學會一種你所選擇的語言，這個語言通常會是你的宿敵、或與之有關的生物所使用的語言。然而，你可以自由選擇任意一種你想要學會的語言。

classFeatures.name: 自然探索者
entries: 你熟練於在自然世界中領航帶路，且你在被襲擊時也能迅速而果斷的做出反應。這賦予了你下列好處：

items: 你無視困難地形。
你在先攻檢定中具有優勢。
在你戰鬥中的第一個回合，你在對任何尚未行動的生物所進行的攻擊檢定中具有優勢。

entries: 此外，你精通於在荒野中領航。當旅行長達1個小時或更久，你將獲得下列好處：

items: 困難地形不會減慢你們團隊的旅行速度。
除非是因為魔法的緣故，否則你們團隊不會迷路。
即使你在旅行途中正從事於其他行動（像是覓食、導航、或追跡），你仍保持對危險的警戒。
若你正獨自旅行，你能夠以正常步調隱匿移動。
當你覓食時，你能找到二倍你原本所能找到的食物。
當你追跡其他生物時，你也能得知它們確切的數量、它們的體型、以及它們在多久之前經過這片區域。

classFeatures.name: 施法
entries: 在你升至2級時，你學會如同德魯伊的方式使用大自然的精粹以施放法術。請參閱{@book 第十章|PHB|10}以了解關於施法的規則，以及第十一章以查閱{@filter 遊俠法術列表|spells|class=ranger}。

entries.name: 法術位
entries: 遊俠表中顯示了你有多少個法術位可以用來施放你一環或更高環的{@filter 遊俠法術|spells|class=ranger}。要施放其中一個法術，你必須消耗一個與該法術環階相同或更高的法術位。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的法術位。
舉例來說，如果你知曉一個1環的{@spell 化獸為友}法術，且你擁有一個1環和一個2環的法術位，則你可以使用其中任意一個法術位來施放{@spell 化獸為友}。

entries.name: 一環或更高環的已知法術
entries: 你知曉二個從遊俠法術列表中自選的1環法術。
遊俠表中的已知法術欄位顯示你將在何時學習到更多自選的遊俠法術。每個這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。舉例來說，當你在此職業升至5級時，你可以學習一個新的1環或2環法術。
此外，當你提升這個職業的等級時，你可以從遊俠的法術列表中挑選一個法術來取代一個你目前已知的法術，而它的環階也必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。

entries.name: 施法屬性
entries: 由於你的魔法是源自你與大自然的協調，睿知是你施展遊俠法術的施法屬性。每當法術提及你的施法屬性時，你將使用你的睿知。此外，當決定你遊俠法術的豁免DC、以及使用遊俠法術進行攻擊檢定時，你使用你的睿知調整值。

classFeatures.name: 戰鬥風格
entries: 在2級時，你採用一種特殊的戰鬥風格以做為你的專業。從下列選項中選擇一種。你不能獲得相同的戰鬥風格選項超過一次，即使你有機會再選擇它也一樣。

entries.name: 弓道
entries: 你在使用遠程武器進行的攻擊檢定中獲得+2加值。

entries.name: 近身射手
entries: 當你在距離一個敵意生物5呎以內時進行一次遠程攻擊，你在該攻擊檢定中並不會具有劣勢。你的遠程攻擊忽略距離你30呎內目標的半掩護和四分之三掩護。你在遠程攻擊的攻擊檢定中獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 防禦
entries: 當你穿戴護甲時，你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 決鬥
entries: 當你單手持用一把近戰武器，且沒有持用其他武器時，你在使用該武器所進行的傷害骰中獲得+2加值。

entries.name: 水手
entries: 只要你未穿戴重甲或使用盾牌，你就擁有等同於你正常移動速度的游泳速度和攀爬速度，且你的AC獲得+1加值。

entries.name: 坑道鬥士
entries: 以一個附贈動作，你可以進入防禦架式並持續直到你的下個回合開始。當你處於防禦架式時，你可以進行藉機攻擊而無需使用你的反應，且你可以處於你觸及範圍內的生物移動超過5呎時使用你的反應對它進行一次近戰攻擊。

entries.name: 雙武器戰鬥
entries: 當你進行雙武器戰鬥時，你可以將你的屬性調整值加入第二次攻擊的傷害中。

classFeatures.name: 原初意識
entries: 從3級開始，你在遊俠學識上的專業讓你得以建立一道與你周圍野獸和環境之間的連結。
你具有一種與野獸交流的天賦能力，且它們將視你為精神上的同類。透過聲音和姿勢，你能夠以一個動作對一個野獸傳達簡單的想法，並可以理解它基本的情緒和意圖。你能得知它的情緒狀態、判斷它是否受到任何魔法的影響、它的短期需求（像是食物或安全的場所）、且你得知你要說服它不攻擊所應採取的行動（若有）。
你不能對一個你在最近10分鐘內曾經攻擊過的生物使用這個能力。
此外，你可以調整你的感官以判斷附近是否潛伏著你的宿敵。透過花費1分鐘不受干擾的專注（如同專注於法術），你可以感知到是否有任何宿敵存在於距離你5哩內的區域之中。這能力將揭露出你的宿敵是否存在、它們的數量、以及這些生物離你大致的方向和距離（以哩為單位）。
若範圍中有複數個宿敵群體，則你將得知它們各自的情報。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠密會
entries: 在3級時，你從可選密會列表中選擇一種你致力於達成的理想範型。你的選擇將在3級、5級、7級、11級、和15級時賦予你新的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至4級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠密會能力
entries: 在5級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠密會所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 高等宿敵
entries: 在6級時，你已經準備好狩獵更加致命的獵物。選擇一個高等宿敵類型：{@filter 異怪|bestiary|type=aberration}、{@filter 天界生物|bestiary|type=celestial}、{@filter 構裝|bestiary|type=construct}、{@filter 龍|bestiary|type=dragon}、{@filter 元素|bestiary|type=elemental}、{@filter 邪魔|bestiary|type=fiend}、或{@filter 巨人|bestiary|type=giant}。你獲得所有你在獲得宿敵能力時所會獲得的好處，包括一種額外語言。你對你所有宿敵的傷害骰加值提升至+4。
此外，你在對抗任何高等宿敵所使用的法術和能力時所進行豁免檢定中具有優勢。

classFeatures.name: 遊俠密會能力
entries: 在7級時，你獲得一個由你遊俠密會所賦予的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至8級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 輕盈步伐
