你可以施放你的祕法法術一次而不需要消耗法術位。你必須在完成一次長休之後才能再次施展。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至19級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 魔能大師
entries: 在20級時，你可以在懇求你的宗主時動用你體內儲備的神祕能量以恢復你花費掉的法術位。你可以花費1分鐘的時間懇求你宗主的協助以恢復所有你花費掉的來自契約魔法的法術位。一旦你透過此能力恢復法術位，你必須在完成一次長休之後才能再次使用此能力。

subclassFeatures.name: 至高妖精
entries: 你的宗主是一位妖精領主或女爵，一個掌握著在世俗種族誕生前便早已被遺忘秘密的傳說生物。這個存在的行為動機往往難以理解，ｕ有時反覆無常，且可能涉及爭取更強大的魔法力量、或解決久遠以前延續至今的仇恨。這類的存在包括了霜凍親王、薄暮之地的統治者空暗女王、仲夏之地的女王緹坦妮雅、她的配偶蒼翠之王奧伯龍、愚者之王希爾薩姆、以及古老的鬼婆們。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，至高妖精宗主讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.caption: 至高妖精擴展法術
rows: {@spell 安定心神}, {@spell 魅影之力}
{@spell 支配野獸}, {@spell 高等隱形術}

entries.name: 妖精威儀
entries: 從1級開始，你的宗主賜予你散發出令人著迷和恐懼的精族威儀。以一個動作，你可以使每個在以你為中心的10呎邊長立方體範圍內的生物進行一次對抗你契術師法術豁免DC的睿知豁免。豁免失敗的生物將被你{@condition 魅惑}或{@condition 恐懼}（由你決定）直到你的下個回合結束。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 霧遁
entries: 從6級開始，你可以在受到傷害時於一團迷霧中消失無蹤。每當你受到傷害時，你可以使用你的反應變得{@condition 隱形}，並傳送最遠60呎距離到一處你所能看見的未被佔據空間。你保持{@condition 隱形}狀態直到你的下個回合開始，或直到你攻擊或施放法術。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 迷惑防護
entries: 從10級開始，你的宗主教導你如何逆轉你敵人的心靈影響魔法以對付它們。你免疫於{@condition 魅惑}，且當另一個生物嘗試魅惑你時，你可以使用你的反應以將該魅惑效果返還給該生物。該生物必須成功通過一次對抗你契術師法術豁免DC的睿知豁免，否則被你{@condition 魅惑}持續1分鐘，或直到該生物受到任何傷害。

entries.name: 黑暗妄霧
entries: 從14級開始，你可以讓一個生物陷入幻覺領域之中。以一個動作，選擇一個距離你60呎內且你所能看見的生物。它必須進行一次對抗你契術師法術豁免DC的睿知豁免。若豁免失敗，它將被你{@condition 魅惑}或{@condition 恐懼}（由你決定）持續1分鐘或直到你的專注被打斷（如同你專注於一個法術）。這個效果會在目標受到任何傷害時提早結束。
直到這個幻象結束之前，該生物將認為自己迷失在一片迷霧領域之中，迷霧領域的外觀由你決定。該生物只能看見和聽見它自己、你、以及幻象。
你必須完成一次短休或長休才能再次使用此能力。

subclassFeatures.name: 邪魔宗主
entries: 即使你可能致力對抗於它們的邪惡目的，你仍與一個來自下層位面的邪魔締結了契約。這類存在渴望著世間萬物的腐化或破壞，最終也包括了你。那些強大到足以締造契約的邪魔包括了像是狄摩高根、奧庫斯、弗拉茲厄魯、和巴菲門特這類的惡魔領主；阿斯蒙帝斯、迪斯帕特、墨菲斯托菲利斯、和貝利亞這類的大魔鬼；特別強大的pit fiends和balors；以及ultroloths和其他尤格羅斯魔領主。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，邪魔宗主讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.caption: 邪魔擴展法術
rows: {@spell 目盲/耳聾術}, {@spell 灼熱射線}

entries.name: 黑暗者賜福
entries: 從1級開始，當你將一個敵對生物的生命值歸零時，你獲得等同於你魅力調整值+你契術師等級的臨時生命值（最少為1）。

entries.name: 黑暗者強運
entries: 從6級開始，你可以呼求你的宗主為了你改變命運。當你進行一次屬性檢定或豁免檢定時，你可以使用此能力以將一顆{@dice d10}加入你的擲骰結果中。你可以在看見一開始的擲骰結果之後，但任何檢定效果發生之前使用此能力。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 邪魔韌性
entries: 從10級開始，你可以在完成一次短休或長休時選擇一種傷害類型。你獲得對該傷害類型的抗性，持續直到你使用此能力再選擇一種不同的傷害類型為止。魔法武器或銀製武器所造成的傷害將忽略此抗性。

entries.name: 直墮地獄
entries: 從14級開始，當你以一次攻擊命中一個生物，你可以使用此能力立刻將該目標傳送穿過下層位面。該生物將消失並飛馳穿過地獄那噩夢般的景象。
在你的下個回合結束時，目標將返回它原先所佔據的空間，或最近的一處未被佔據空間。若目標並非邪魔，則它將因為那恐怖的經歷而受到{@dice 10d10}精神傷害。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: Ghost in the Machine
entries: You have made a bargain for power granted by an entity that you believe to be completely digital. Whether it is a rogue AI or the spirit of a deceased hacker, the Ghost in the Machine is capable of feats that defy explanation.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Ghost in the Machine lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. You gain the on/off cantrip, and the following new spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.
Spells marked with an asterisk can be found in Unearthed Arcana: Modern Magic.

entries.caption: Ghost in the Machine Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell infallible relay (UA)|UAModernMagic|infallible relay}*, {@spell remote access (UA)|UAModernMagic|remote access}*
{@spell arcane hacking (UA)|UAModernMagic|arcane hacking}*, {@spell digital phantom (UA)|UAModernMagic|digital phantom}*
{@spell haywire (UA)|UAModernMagic|haywire}*, {@spell invisibility to cameras (UA)|UAModernMagic|invisibility to cameras}*
{@spell conjure knowbot (UA)|UAModernMagic|conjure knowbot}*, {@spell system backdoor (UA)|UAModernMagic|system backdoor}*

entries.name: Bonus Proficiency
entries: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with hacking tools.

entries.name: Information Surge
entries: At 1st level, you gain the ability to temporarily render computerized devices inoperable. As an action, you can target a computerized device within 30 feet of you. If the targeted device is held or otherwise actively used by a living creature, that creature must make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the targeted device ceases to function until the end of your next turn. If the targeted device is not held or used by a creature, the DM makes a special saving throw for the device with disadvantage and a +0 modifier. Certain shielded devices might negate the disadvantage, at the DM's determination.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Wire Walk
entries: Starting at 6th level, you gain the ability to travel short distances over electrical wires, data lines, or telephone cables. As a bonus action, you can touch a device or socket connected to a hardwired network and teleport along this network to another device or socket within your line of sight. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Personal Encryption
entries: Beginning at 10th level, you have learned to apply your innate knowledge of encryption to your thoughts, memories, and presence. You have advantage on saving throws against {@spell scrying}, thought detection, or any other method of magically learning your whereabouts or reading your thoughts. For any such effect that does not grant you a saving throw but which requires the creature targeting you to make an ability check, the check is made with disadvantage.

entries.name: Technovirus
entries: At 14th level, you gain the ability to infect a humanoid's body with living circuitry. You can use an action to make a melee attack against a humanoid creature using your spell attack modifier. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC as a techno-organic virus quickly spreads through its body. On a failed save, the target takes {@dice 8d10} psychic damage, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Additionally, if the target fails the saving throw, you can use an action to issue it a single command, as if you were casting the {@spell 命令術} spell. The target makes its saving throw against your {@spell 命令術} with disadvantage. You can issue this {@spell 命令術} at any time while the target remains infected.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest, at which point the target is cured of the technovirus. The infection can also be removed with a lesser restoration spell.

subclassFeatures.name: 舊日支配者
entries: 你的宗主是一個對現實維度而言徹底異質的神祕存在。它可能來自遙遠國度、現實之外的宇宙、或它可能是其中一位只記述於遠古傳說中的古神。它的行為動機超乎凡人所能理解，且它的知識是如此淵博而古老，與它所擁有的無盡秘密相比，就連世間最偉大的圖書館都會相形見絀。即使舊日支配者可能並未意識到你的存在、或對你完全不感興趣，但你所習得的秘密知識讓你得以利用來自它的龐大魔力。這種類型的存在包括了潛伏者關納德、受縛之神薩瑞茲頓、暗夜巨蛇丹達爾、歸來者扎貢、偉大的克蘇魯、以及其他無以名狀的存在。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，舊日支配者宗主讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.caption: 舊日支配者擴展法術
rows: {@spell 噪音暗語}, {@spell 塔莎狂笑術}
{@spell 偵測思想}, {@spell 魅影之力}
{@spell 支配野獸}, {@spell 艾伐黑觸手}
{@spell 支配人類}, {@spell 心靈遙控}

entries.name: 喚醒心靈
entries: 從1級開始，你的異界知識賦予了你接觸其他生物心靈的能力。你可以對距離你30呎內且你所能看見的一個生物透過心靈感應交談。你不需要與該生物有共通的語言，就能使它理解你透過心靈感應所傳達的話語，但該生物必須至少理解一種語言。

entries.name: 熵光防護
entries: 在6級時，你學會用魔法從攻擊中守護自己，並將敵人失手的打擊轉變成你自己的好運。當一個生物對你進行一次攻擊檢定時，你可以使用你的反應以讓該檢定承受劣勢。若該攻擊失手，則直到你的下個回合結束前，你下一次對該生物進行的攻擊檢定將獲得優勢。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 思想護盾
entries: 從10級開始，除非你允許，否則你的思想不會被心靈感應或任何其他方式閱讀。你同時獲得對精神傷害的抗性，且每當一個生物對你造成精神傷害，該生物將受到與你相同的傷害。

entries.name: 創造奴僕
entries: 在14級時，你獲得用來自你宗主的異界魔法感染一個類人生物心靈的能力。你可以使用你的動作去觸碰一個處於{@condition 無力}狀態的類人生物。該生物接著將被你{@condition 魅惑}，持續直到它被施放{@spell 移除詛咒}法術、{@condition 魅惑}狀態被移除、或你再次使用此能力為止。
只要你和該生物還處在相同的存在位面，你就可以透過心靈感應與被{@condition 魅惑}的生物交談。

subclassFeatures.name: ​不朽者
entries: 早已解開永生生命的秘密，死亡不再影響你的宗主，儘管這樣的成果—就如同所有的力量—伴隨著代價。即使曾為凡人，不朽者看凡俗壽命的消逝如同四季更迭，如同無盡日夜交替中閃爍的火花。它握有關於年壽的秘密、關於生與死的秘密，並不吝於將其分享給追隨它的凡人。這類存在包括萬隱萬秘的主宰維克那、恐懼者埃烏茲、巫妖女王沃爾、艾倫諾的不朽評議會、吉斯洋基人的巫妖女皇維拉基斯、以及不死法師費斯坦丹提勒斯。
在被遺忘的國度中，不朽者宗主包括了巫師之墓的傳說之主，陰影之王拉洛克、以及巫瑟的神王吉爾金。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，不朽者宗主讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.caption: 不朽者擴展法術
rows: {@spell 摹造生命}, {@spell 致病射線}
{@spell 目盲/耳聾術}, {@spell 沉默術}
{@spell 假死術}, {@spell 死者交談術}
{@spell 生命靈光}, {@spell 防死護咒}

entries.name: 常伴死亡
entries: 從1級開始，你學會{@spell 拯救瀕死}戲法，且它對你而言視作契術師戲法。你同時在對抗任何疾病的豁免檢定中具有優勢。

此外，不死生物將難以傷害你。若一個不死生物直接指定你做為一次攻擊或傷害性法術的目標，該生物必須進行一次對抗你法術豁免DC的睿知豁免（不死生物在使用會捲入你的範圍效果時並不需要進行此檢定，像是{@spell 火球術}的爆炸範圍）。若豁免失敗，該生物必須選擇一個新的目標、或者放棄指定除了你之外的某人，這可能會導致該攻擊或法術被浪費。若豁免成功，該生物將在接下來24小時內免疫於此效果。若你指定它為一次攻擊或傷害性法術的目標，則該不死生物也將在接下來24小時內免疫於此效果。

entries.name: 反抗死亡
entries: 從6級開始，你可以在欺騙死亡或幫助他人欺騙死亡時賦予自己活力。當你成功通過一次死亡豁免、或當你使用{@spell 拯救瀕死}穩定一個生物的傷勢時，你將回復等同於{@dice 1d8}+你的體質調整值（最少1點）的生命值。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

entries.name: 不朽天性
entries: 從10級開始，你可以永遠地屏住氣息，且你不再需要食物、飲水、或睡眠。儘管你仍然需要休息才能減輕{@condition 耗竭}等級，且仍會得到完成短休和長休的好處。
此外，你會以較慢的速度老化。每10年過去，你的身體只會老化1年，且你免疫於被魔法變老。

entries.name: 不滅生命
entries: 當你升至14級時，你分享了一些不朽者宗主的真理秘密。在你的回合，你可以使用一個附贈動作以回復等同於{@dice 1d8}+你的契術師等級的生命值。此外，若你在使用此能力時將一個你斷掉的身體部位放回它原本的位置，該部位將會重新接合。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: The Undying Light
entries: Your patron is not a specific entity, but the energy that radiates from the Positive Plane. Your pact allows you to experience the barest touch of the raw stuff of life that powers the multiverse. Anything more, and you would be instantly incinerated by its energy.

Contact with the Positive Plane causes subtle changes to your behavior and beliefs. You are driven to bring light to dark places, to annihilate undead creatures, and to protect all living things. At the same time, you crave the light and find total darkness a suffocating experience akin to drowning.
As an optional way to add more flavor to your character, you can pick from or roll on the following table of flaws associated with warlocks of the Undying Light.

entries.caption: Undying Light Flaws
rows: You are afraid of the dark, and must always have a light source at hand.
You have a nervous compulsion to keep a bright light in even the barest shadow.
You have a compulsion to enter and illuminate dark areas.
You have an overwhelming hatred of undead creatures.
You fidget and are irritable when you can't see the sun.
In a dark area, you always carry a lit torch or lantern. Putting it down is an unbearable thought.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Undying Light lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.name: Radiant Soul
entries: Starting at 1st level, your link to the Positive Plane allows you to serve as a conduit for radiant energy. You have resistance to radiant damage, and when you cast a spell that deals radiant damage or fire damage, you add your Charisma modifier to that damage. Additionally, you know the {@spell 聖焰} and {@spell 光亮術} cantrips and can cast them at will. They don't count against your number of cantrips known.

entries.name: Searing Vengeance
entries: Starting at 6th level, the radiant energy you channel allows you to overcome grievous injuries. When you would make a death saving throw, you can instead spring back to your feet with a burst of radiant energy. You immediately stand up (if you so choose), and you regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum. All hostile creatures within 30 feet of you take 10 + your Charisma modifier radiant damage and are {@condition blinded} until the end of your turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Radiant Resilience
entries: Starting at 10th level, you gain temporary hit points whenever you finish a long or short rest. These temporary hit points equal your warlock level + your Charisma modifier. Additionally, choose up to five creatures you can see at the end of your rest. Those creatures gain temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Healing Light
entries: At 14th level, you gain the ability to channel the Undying Light to heal yourself and other creatures. As a bonus action, you can touch a creature and heal it. With each touch, a creature regains from {@dice 1d6} to {@dice 5d6} hit points (your choice). You have a total pool of {@dice 15d6} you can expend. Subtract the dice you use with each touch from that total.
You regain all expended dice from your pool when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: The Celestial
entries: Your patron is a powerful being of the Upper Planes. You have bound yourself to an ancient empyrean, solar, ki-rin, or unicorn or to another entity that resides in the planes of everlasting bliss. Your pact with that being allows you to experience the barest touch of the holy light that illuminates the multiverse.

Being connected to such power can cause changes in your behavior and beliefs. You might find yourself driven to annihilate the undead, to defeat fiends, and to protect the innocent. At times, your heart might also be filled with a longing for the celestial realm of your patron, a desire to wander that paradise for the rest of your days. But you know that your mission is among mortals for now and that your pact binds you to bring light to the dark places of the world.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Celestial lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.caption: Celestial Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell 燃燒之手}, {@spell 治療傷勢}
{@spell 熾焰法球}, {@spell 次級復原術}
{@spell 焰擊術}, {@spell 高等復原術}

entries.name: Bonus Cantrips
entries: At 1st level, you learn the {@spell 聖焰} and {@spell 光亮術} cantrips. They count as warlock cantrips for you, but they don't count against your number of cantrips known.

entries.name: Healing Light
entries: At 1st level, you gain the ability to channel celestial energy to heal wounds. You have a pool of {@dice d6}s that you spend to fuel this healing. The number of dice in the pool equals 1 + your warlock level.

As a bonus action, you can touch a creature and heal it, spending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can spend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you spend, add them together, and restore a number of hit points equal to the total.
Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Radiant Soul
entries: Starting at 6th level, your link to the Celestial allows you to serve as a conduit for radiant energy. You have resistance to radiant damage, and when you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, you add your Charisma modifier to that damage against one target of your choice.

entries.name: Celestial Resilience
entries: Starting at 10th level, you gain temporary hit points whenever you finish a short or long rest. These temporary hit points equal your warlock level + your Charisma modifier. Additionally, choose up to five creatures you can see at the end of the rest. Those creatures each gain temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Healing Light
entries: Starting at 14th level, the radiant energy you channel allows you to overcome grievous injuries. When you have to make a death saving throw at the start of your turn, you can instead spring back to your feet with a burst of radiant energy. You regain hit points equal to half your hit point maximum, and then you stand up, if you so choose. Each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to {@dice 2d8} + your Charisma modifier, and it is {@condition blinded} until the end of the current turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: The Seeker
entries: Your patron is an inscrutable being who travels the Astral Plane in search of knowledge and secrets. In return for your patron's gifts, you wander the world seeking lore that you can share with the Seeker.

Your patron could be any deity or other powerful entity dedicated to knowledge or forgotten lore. Celestian is an ideal patron for a Greyhawk campaign, and was the inspiration for this concept. In the Forgotten Realms, your patron might be Azuth or Oghma. Aureon makes an excellent patron in Eberron, while in Krynn and the Dragonlance campaign setting, Gilean is a good match for the Seeker's role.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Seeker lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.caption: Seeker Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell 浮空術}, {@spell 物品定位術}
{@spell 祕法眼}, {@spell 生物定位術}

entries.name: Shielding Aurora
entries: Starting at 1st level, you can invoke the Seeker's power to protect you from harm. As a bonus action, you create a whirling aurora of brilliant energy that swirls around you. Until the end of your next turn, you gain resistance to all damage, and if a hostile creature ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes radiant damage equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Astral Refuge
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to step into an astral refuge. As an action, you disappear from the world for a brief moment and enter the Astral Plane, taking advantage of its timeless nature. While in your astral refuge, you can take two actions to cast spells that target only you. After using those two actions, you return to the space you occupied and your turn ends.

entries.name: Far Wanderer
entries: At 10th level, you no longer need to breathe, and you gain resistance to fire damage and cold damage.

entries.name: Astral Sequestration
entries: Starting at 14th level, you gain the ability to sequester yourself and your allies on the Astral Plane.

By performing a special ritual over the course of 5 minutes, you shift yourself and up to ten willing creatures you can see to the Astral Plane. You and those creatures gain the benefits of a short rest while sequestered on the Astral Plane. You then return to the spaces you all occupied when you used this ability, with no time having passed in the world.
During this short rest, you and the creatures you sequester can make use of any options available during a rest that affect only you and the creatures you sequester.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: The Raven Queen
entries: You patron is the Raven Queen, a mysterious being who rules the Shadowfell from a palace of ice deep within that dread realm. The Raven Queen watches over the world, anticipating each creature's death and ensuring that it meets its end at the proscribed time and place. As the ruler of the Shadowfell, she dwells in a decayed, dark reflection of the world. Her ability to reach into the world is limited. Thus, she turns to mortal warlocks to serve her will. Warlocks sworn to the Raven Queen receive visions and whispers from her in their dreams, sending them on quests and warning them of impending dangers.

The Raven Queen's followers are expected to serve her will in the world. She concerns herself with ensuring that those fated to die pass from the world as expected, and bids her agents to defeat those who seek to cheat death through undeath or other imitations of immortality. She hates intelligent undead and expects her followers to strike them down, whereas mindless undead such as skeletons and zombies are little more than stumbling automatons in her eyes.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Raven Queen lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.caption: Raven Queen Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell 假死術}, {@spell 死者交談術}
{@spell 冰風暴}, {@spell 生物定位術}

entries.name: Sentinel Raven
entries: Starting at 1st level, you gain the service of a spirit sent by the Raven Queen to watch over you. The spirit assumes the form and game statistics of a raven, and it always obeys your commands, which you can give telepathically while it is within 100 feet of you.

While the raven is perched on your shoulder, you gain darkvision with a range of 30 feet and a bonus to your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score and to Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier. While perched on your shoulder, the raven can't be targeted by any attack or other harmful effect; only you can cast spells on it; it can't take damage; and it is {@condition incapacitated}.

You can see through the raven's eyes and hear what it hears while it is within 100 feet of you. In combat, you roll initiative for the raven and control how it acts. If it is slain by a creature, you gain advantage on all attack rolls against the killer for the next 24 hours.

The raven doesn't require sleep. While it is within 100 feet of you, it can awaken you from sleep as a bonus action. The raven vanishes when it dies, if you die, or if the two of you are separated by more than 5 miles.
At the end of a short or long rest, you can call the raven back to you—no matter where it is or whether it died—and it reappears within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Soul of the Raven
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to merge with your raven spirit. As a bonus action when your raven is perched on your shoulder, your body merges with your raven's form. While merged, you become Tiny, you replace your speed with the raven's, and you can use your action only to {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Dodge}, {@action Help}, {@action Hide}, or {@action Search}. During this time, you gain the benefits of your raven being perched on your shoulder. As an action, you and the raven return to normal.

entries.name: Raven's Shield
entries: At 10th level, the Raven Queen grants you a protective blessing. You gain advantage on death saving throws, immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition, and resistance to necrotic damage.

entries.name: Queen's Right Hand
entries: Starting at 14th level, you can channel the Raven Queen's power to slay a creature. You can cast {@spell finger of death}. After you cast the spell with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: The Hexblade
entries: You have made your pact with a powerful, sentient magic weapon carved from the stuff of the Shadowfell. The mighty sword Blackrazor is the most notable of these weapons, several of which have spread across the multiverse over the ages. These weapons grow stronger as they consume the life essence of their victims. The strongest of them can use their ties to the Shadowfell to offer power to mortals who serve them. The Raven Queen forged the first of these weapons. They, along with the hexblade warlocks, are another tool she can use to manipulate events in the Material Plane to her inscrutable ends.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Hexblade lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.name: Hex Warrior
entries: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. In addition, when attacking with a melee weapon that you are proficient with and that lacks the two-handed property, you can use your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls.

entries.name: Hexblade's Curse
entries: Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to place a baleful curse on an enemy. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a bonus to damage rolls against the cursed target. The bonus equals your proficiency bonus.
Any attack roll you make against the cursed target is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.
If the cursed target dies, you regain hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.

entries: You can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Shadow Hound
entries: Starting at 6th level, your shadow can split from you and transform into a hound of pure darkness. Most of the time, your shadow hound masquerades as your normal shadow. As a bonus action, you can command it to magically slip into the shadow of a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. While the shadow hound is merged in this manner, the target can't gain the benefits of half cover or three-quarters cover against your attack rolls, and you know the distance and direction to the target even if it is hidden. The hound can't be seen by anyone but you and those with truesight, and it is unaffected by light. The target has a vague feeling of dread while the hound is present.

As a bonus action, you can command your shadow hound to return to you. It also automatically returns to you if you and the target are on different planes of existence, if you're {@condition incapacitated}, or if dispel magic, {@spell remove curse}, or similar magic is used on the target.

entries.name: Armor of Hexes
entries: At 10th level, your hex grows more powerful. If the target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse hits you with an attack roll, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 4 or higher, the attack instead misses you.

entries.name: Master of Hexes
entries: Starting at 14th level, you can use your Hexblade's Curse again without resting, but when you apply it to a new target, the curse immediately ends on the previous target.

subclassFeatures.name: 天界宗主
entries: 你的宗主是一個上層位面的強大存在。你和一位古老的至高天、熾天神侍、麒麟、獨角獸、或其他居住於那永樂位面中的存在締結了契約。你與該存在之間的契約讓你得以經歷到那照亮多元宇宙的聖光最直接的觸碰。
與這般力量的連接可能會導致你行為和信仰的改變。你可能會發現自己投身於殲滅不死生物、抵禦邪魔、和保護無辜者的大業中。有時候，你的心靈會充滿著你對宗主所在天界國度的渴望，並希冀能在你的餘生中漫遊在這樣的天堂之中。然而，你知道你現在的任務是待在凡世之中，且你的契約約束著你為世界上最黑暗的角落帶來光明。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，天界宗主讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.caption: 天界宗主擴展法術
rows: {@spell 熾焰法球}, {@spell 次級復原術}
{@spell 焰擊術}, {@spell 高等復原術}

entries.name: 額外戲法
entries: 在1級時，你學會{@spell 聖焰}和{@spell 光亮術}戲法。它們對你而言視作契術師戲法，但不會被計入你已知戲法的數量中。

entries.name: 治癒之光
entries: 在1級時，你獲得引導天界能量以醫治傷口的能力。你獲得一組{@dice d6}骰池，並可以消耗它來使用此治療能力。骰池中的骰子數量等同於1+你的契術師等級。
以一個附贈動作，你可以消耗骰池中的骰子，治療一個距離你60呎內且你能看見的生物。你一次所能消耗的最大骰數等同於你的魅力調整值（最少一顆骰）。投擲你所消耗的骰子，將它們加在一起，並回復等同於其總和的生命值。
你的骰池將在你完成一次長休時恢復所有花費掉的骰子。

entries.name: 光輝之魂
entries: 從6級開始，你與天界宗主的聯繫讓你得以做為釋放光耀能量的管道。你對光耀傷害具有抗性，且當你施放一個會造成光耀或火焰傷害的法術時，你可以將你的魅力調整值加入對其中一個目標所造成的一次光耀或火焰傷害骰中。

entries.name: 天族韌性
entries: 從10級開始，每當你完成一次短休或長休時，你將獲得臨時生命值。這些臨時生命值等同於你的契術師等級+你的魅力調整值。此外，在休息結束時選擇最多五個你所能看見的生物。這些生物將各自獲得等同於你契術師等級的一半+你的魅力調整值的臨時生命值。

entries.name: 灼光復仇
entries: 從14級開始，你所引導的光耀能量讓你得以抵抗死亡。當你在你的回合開始時必須進行一次死亡豁免時，你可以改為在一陣光耀能量的爆發中一躍而起。你回復等同於你生命值最大值一半的生命值，並接著可以選擇重新起身。每個距離你30呎內你所選擇的生物將受到等同於{@dice 2d8}+你的魅力調整值的光耀傷害，且陷入{@condition 目盲}狀態直到該回合結束。
一旦你使用此能力，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用它。

subclassFeatures.name: 咒劍士
entries: 你和一個來自墮影冥界的神秘存在締結了契約—一股在暗影物質雕琢而成的智能魔法武器身上顯露出的力量。強大的魔劍「黑刃」就是這類武器中最著名的一例，並以在世紀間輾轉橫跨多元宇宙。這些武器背後的陰影之力可以為與之締結契約的契術師提供力量。許多咒劍契術師模仿著那些在墮影冥界中成形的存在來創造自己的武器，其他人則放棄這類兵器，轉而將墮影冥界中的黑暗魔法編入他們的法術施展中。
由於眾所周知，是鴉后打造出了最初的這類武器，因此許多賢者推測她就是這股力量的真身，且這些武器、以及咒劍契術師，都只不過是她用以操弄物質位面的工具，用以達到她那難以揣測的最終目的。

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: 當你要學習契術師法術時，咒劍士讓你可以從擴展法術列表中選擇法術。對你而言下列法術將被加入契術師法術列表。

entries.name: 咒劍詛咒
entries: 從1級開始，你獲得向某人施加惡毒詛咒的能力。以一個附贈動作，選擇一個距離你30呎內且你能看見的生物。目標將被詛咒長達1分鐘。這個詛咒會在目標死亡、你死亡、或你陷入{@condition 無力}狀態時提早結束。直到此詛咒結束前，你獲得下列好處：

items: 你對受詛咒目標所進行的傷害骰獲得加值。這個加值等同於你的熟練加值。
任何你對受詛咒目標所進行的攻擊檢定，若在{@dice d20}中骰出19或20的骰面，則該攻擊視為重擊。
若受詛咒目標死亡，你將回復等同於你契術師等級+你的魅力調整值的生命值（最少1點生命值）。

entries: 直到你完成一次短休或長休之前你都不能再使用此能力。

entries.name: 巫咒戰士
entries: 在1級時，你學會了在戰鬥中有效武裝自己所必要的訓練。你獲得中甲、盾牌、和軍用武器的熟練。
你宗主的影響也讓你得以神秘地透過特定武器引導你的意志。每當你完成一次長休，你可以觸碰一把你所熟練且沒有雙手屬性的武器。當你使用該武器進行攻擊時，你可以使用你的魅力調整值，而非力量或敏捷，來計算其攻擊檢定和傷害骰。這個好處會持續直到你完成一次長休。若你之後獲得了鋒刃魔契能力，則這個好處將擴展到你使用該能力召喚出的每一把契約武器，且無視武器類型的限制。

entries.name: 咒縛幽靈
entries: 從6級開始，你可以詛咒一個你所殺害之人的靈魂，束縛它暫時為你服務。當你殺死一個類人生物時，你可以使它的靈魂做為一個{@creature 幽靈}從它的屍體中升起。幽靈的數據被記載於《怪物圖鑑》中。當幽靈出現時，它將獲得等同於你契術師等級一半的臨時生命值。為這個幽靈骰先攻，且它擁有自己的回合。它會服從你的任何口頭指令，且它在它的攻擊檢定中獲得等同於你魅力調整值（最低為+0）的特殊加值。
這個幽靈會持續為你服務直到你的下一次長休結束，在那之後它將消失並進入來世。
一旦你使用此能力束縛一個幽靈，直到你完成一次長休之前你都不能再使用此能力。

entries.name: 巫咒護甲
entries: 在10級時，你的巫咒變得更加強大。若你使用咒劍詛咒所詛咒的目標以一次攻擊檢定命中你，你可以使用你的反應骰一顆{@dice d6}。若結果為4或更高，則無論該攻擊的檢定結果如何，該攻擊結果改為失手。

entries.name: 巫咒大師
entries: 從14級開始，你可以將你的咒劍詛咒從一個被殺死的生物散佈到另一個生物身上。當一個被你使用咒劍詛咒所詛咒的生物死亡時，只要你不處於{@condition 無力}狀態，你就可以將該詛咒轉移到一個距離你30呎內且你能看見的不同生物。當你透過這個方法轉移詛咒，你將不能因為前一個受詛咒生物的死亡而回復生命值。

subclassFeatures.name: The Kraken (Livestream)
entries: You made a pact with a Kraken somewhere in the world's ocean.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: The Kraken lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.caption: Kraken Patron Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell 雷鳴波}, {@spell 造水/枯水術}
{@spell 艾伐黑觸手}, {@spell 操控水體}

entries.name: Grasp of the Kraken
entries: Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to call forth spectral tentacles that grab at your foes. As an action, pick a point that you can see within 60 ft. of you. A horde of grasping tendrils appears at that point. Creatures of your choice within 10 ft. of that point must make a Strength saving throw against your Warlock spell save DC. Creatures that fail their saving throws are {@condition grappled} for 1 minute or until you use this ability again. The spectral tentacle's Strength ({@skill Athletics}) bonus is 2 + your proficiency bonus and its reach is 10 feet.

entries.name: Inky Escape
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to call upon your patron to escape from your foes. As a reaction when you take damage, you can cast {@spell darkness} centered on a point within 5 ft. of you. The spell lasts until the end of your next turn, and it has no effect on your vision.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it until you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Scion of the Depths
entries: Starting at 10th level, your patron accepts you into his inner court of servitors. You gain the ability to breathe water, and a swim speed equal to your normal speed.

You gain immunity to lightning damage. When your immunity reduces damage from an effect to 0, as a reaction you can cause creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 ft. of you to take lightning damage equal to your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Unleash the Kraken
entries: At 14th level, you gain the ability to call upon your patron for aid. As an action, you open a portal at a point you can see within 30 ft. of you and choose one of the following effects.

entries.name: Transport
entries: You and up to 5 creatures of your choosing that you can see are grasped by tentacles that emerge from the portal. A second portal opens at a point of your choice within 100 miles that you have visited in the past 24 hours, depositing you and your chosen allies there.

entries.name: Fury
entries: The tentacles slam into your foes. Pick up to 5 creatures that you can see within 30 ft. of the portal. Those creatures must make Dexterity saving throws against your Warlock spell save DC. Creatures that fail their saving throws take {@dice 10d6} bludgeoning damage and are {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. Creatures that succeed take half the bludgeoning damage and are not {@condition restrained}. On its turn, a {@condition restrained} creature can use its action to attempt a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to end its {@condition restrained} condition.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it until you complete a long rest.

subclassFeatures.name: Lolth (Twitter)
entries: Your patron is Lolth, queen of the dark fey. She rules over the drow that dwell within the Feywild, and commands the loyalty of all hags. Evil fey pay her respect, though not all obey her edicts. She is a sworn enemy of Torog, due to the constant threat he and his minions pose to her Underdark domains.

entries.name: 擴展法術列表
entries: Lolth lets you choose from an expanded list of spells when you learn a warlock spell. The following spells are added to the warlock spell list for you.

entries.caption: Lolth Expanded Spells
rows: {@spell 恐懼術}, {@spell 吸血鬼之觸}
{@spell 死雲術}, {@spell 怪物定身術}

entries.name: Dark Queen's Servitor
entries: Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into Lolth's most beloved servitor, a giant spider. As a bonus action you turn into a spider. You gain a +2 bonus to AC. You gain 3 temporary hit points per level. You gain a climb speed equal to your normal speed. You can climb difficult surfaces, such as along a ceiling, without needing to make a check. You gain a bite attack. You are proficient with this attack and it inflicts poison damage based on your level. You can use your choice of Strength or Dexterity to modify your bite attack's attack and damage rolls. While in this form, you lack hands and cannot do anything that normally requires them. However, you can cast spells but can only cast the ones listed on your expanded spell list for Lolth.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Poisoned Beauty
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to use a shard of Lolth's alien beauty, causing other creatures to become enraptured by your appearance. As a bonus action, pick a creature you can see. That creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by you. While {@condition charmed}, it also gains vulnerability to poison damage. This benefit lasts for one minute or until you or your allies damages the creature. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Spider Queen's Chosen
entries: At 10th level, Lolth extends her protection to you while you are in her favored form. You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical sources while in your spider form.

entries.name: Kiss of the Spider Queen
entries: Starting at 14th level, you can channel Lolth's malevolence into a deadly kiss. As an action, you touch a creature within your reach. The target takes {@dice 12d10} poison or psychic damage (your choice), or half as much on a successful Constitution save. A creature {@condition charmed} by you has disadvantage on its saving throw. After you use this ability, you cannot cast it again until you complete a long rest.
With a pseudodragon curled on his shoulder, a young elf in golden robes smiles warmly, weaving a magical charm into his honeyed words and bending the palace sentinel to his will.
As flames spring to life in her hands, a wizened human whispers the secret name of her demonic patron, infusing her spell with fiendish magic.
Shifting his gaze between a battered tome and the odd alignment of the stars overhead, a wild-eyed tiefling chants the mystic ritual that will open a doorway to a distant world.

Warlocks are seekers of the knowledge that lies hidden in the fabric of the multiverse. Through pacts made with mysterious beings of supernatural power, warlocks unlock magical effects both subtle and spectacular. Drawing on the ancient knowledge of beings such as fey nobles, demons, devils, hags, and alien entities of the Far Realm, warlocks piece together arcane secrets to bolster their own power.

entries.name: Sworn and Beholden
entries: A warlock is defined by a pact with an otherworldly being. Sometimes the relationship between warlock and patron is like that of a cleric and a deity, though the beings that serve as patrons for warlocks are not gods. A warlock might lead a cult dedicated to a demon prince, an archdevil, or an utterly alien entity—beings not typically served by clerics. More often, though, the arrangement is similar to that between a master and an apprentice. The warlock learns and grows in power, at the cost of occasional services performed on the patron's behalf.

The magic bestowed on a warlock ranges from minor but lasting alterations to the warlock's being (such as the ability to see in darkness or to read any language) to access to powerful spells. Unlike bookish wizards, warlocks supplement their magic with some facility at hand-to-hand combat. They are comfortable in light armor and know how to use simple weapons.

entries.name: Delvers into Secrets
entries: Warlocks are driven by an insatiable need for knowledge and power, which compels them into their pacts and shapes their lives. This thirst drives warlocks into their pacts and shapes their later careers as well.

Stories of warlocks binding themselves to fiends are widely known. But many warlocks serve patrons that are not fiendish. Sometimes a traveler in the wilds comes to a strangely beautiful tower, meets its fey lord or lady, and stumbles into a pact without being fully aware of it. And sometimes, while poring over tomes of forbidden lore, a brilliant but crazed student's mind is opened to realities beyond the material world and to the alien beings that dwell in the outer void.

Once a pact is made, a warlock's thirst for knowledge and power can't be slaked with mere study and research. No one makes a pact with such a mighty patron if he or she doesn't intend to use the power thus gained. Rather, the vast majority of warlocks spend their days in active pursuit of their goals, which typically means some kind of adventuring. Furthermore, the demands of their patrons drive warlocks toward adventure.

entries.name: Creating a Warlock
entries: As you make your warlock character, spend some time thinking about your patron and the obligations that your pact imposes upon you. What led you to make the pact, and how did you make contact with your patron? Were you seduced into summoning a devil, or did you seek out the ritual that would allow you to make contact with an alien elder god? Did you search for your patron, or did your patron find and choose you? Do you chafe under the obligations of your pact or serve joyfully in anticipation of the rewards promised to you?

Work with your DM to determine how big a part your pact will play in your character's adventuring career. Your patron's demands might drive you into adventures, or they might consist entirely of small favors you can do between adventures.

What kind of relationship do you have with your patron? Is it friendly, antagonistic, uneasy, or romantic? How important does your patron consider you to be? What part do you play in your patron's plans? Do you know other servants of your patron?

How does your patron communicate with you? If you have a familiar, it might occasionally speak with your patron's voice. Some warlocks find messages from their patrons etched on trees, mingled among tea leaves, or adrift in the clouds—messages that only the warlock can see. Other warlocks converse with their patrons in dreams or waking visions, or deal only with intermediaries.

entries.name: Quick Build
entries: You can make a warlock quickly by following these suggestions. First, Charisma should be your highest ability score, followed by Constitution. Second, choose the {@background charlatan} background. Third, choose the {@spell eldritch blast} and {@spell chill touch} cantrips, along with the 1st-level spells {@spell charm person} and {@spell witch bolt}.
You think me mad? I think true insanity is being content to live a life of mortal drudgery when knowledge and power is there for the taking in the realm beyond.

Warlocks are finders and keepers of secrets. They push at the edge of our understanding of the world, always seeking to expand their expertise. Where sages or wizards might heed a clear sign of danger and end their research, a warlock plunges ahead, heedless of the cost. Thus, it takes a peculiar mixture of intelligence, curiosity, and recklessness to produce a warlock. Many folk would describe that combination as evidence of madness. Warlocks see it as a demonstration of bravery.

Warlocks are defined by two elements that work in concert to forge their path into this class. The first element is the event or circumstances that led to a warlock's entering into a pact with a planar entity. The second one is the nature of the entity a warlock is bound to. Unlike clerics, who typically embrace a deity and that god's ethos, a warlock might have no love for a patron, or vice versa.
The sections that follow provide ways to embellish a warlock character that could generate some intriguing story and roleplaying opportunities.

entries.name: Patron's Attitude
entries: Every relationship is a two-way street, but in the case of warlocks and their patrons it's not necessarily true that both sides of the street are the same width or made of the same stuff. The feeling that a warlock holds for their patron, whether positive or negative, might be reciprocated by the patron, or the two participants in the pact might view one another with opposing emotions.

When you determine the attitude your warlock character holds toward your patron, also consider how things look from the patron's perspective. How does your patron behave toward you? Is your patron a friend and ally, or an enemy that grants you power only because you forced a pact upon it?

entries.caption: Patron Attitudes
rows: Your patron has guided and helped your family for generations and is kindly toward you.
Each interaction with your capricious patron is a surprise, whether pleasant or painful.
Your patron is the spirit of a long-dead hero who sees your pact as a way for it to continue to influence the world.
Your patron is a strict disciplinarian but treats you with a measure of respect.
Your patron tricked you into a pact and treats you as a slave.
You are mostly left to your own devices with no interference from your patron. Sometimes you dread the demands it will make when it does appear.

entries.name: Special Terms of the Pact
entries: A pact can range from a loose agreement to a formal contract with lengthy, detailed clauses and lists of requirements. The terms of a pact—what a warlock must do to receive a patron's favor—are always dictated by the patron. On occasion, those terms include a special proviso that might seem odd or whimsical, but warlocks take these dictates as seriously as they do the other requirements of their pacts.

Does your character have a pact that requires you to change your behavior in an unusual or seemingly frivolous way? Even if your patron hasn't imposed such a duty on you already, that's not to say it couldn't still happen.

entries.caption: Special Terms
rows: When directed, you must take immediate action against a specific enemy of your patron.
Your pact tests your willpower; you are required to abstain from alcohol and other intoxicants.
At least once a day, you must inscribe or carve your patron's name or symbol on the wall of a building.
You must occasionally conduct bizarre rituals to maintain your pact.
You can never wear the same outfit twice, since your patron finds such predictability to be boring.
When you use an eldritch invocation, you must speak your patron's name aloud or risk incurring its displeasure.

entries.name: Binding Mark
entries: Some patrons make a habit of, and often enjoy, marking the warlocks under their sway in some fashion. A binding mark makes it clear—to those who know about such things—that the individual in question is bound to the patron's service. A warlock might take advantage of such a mark, claiming it as proof of one's pact, or might want to keep it under wraps (if possible) to avoid the difficulties it might bring.

If your warlock's pact comes with a binding mark, how you feel about displaying it probably depends on the nature of your relationship with the one who gave it to you. Is the mark a source of pride or something you are secretly ashamed of?

entries.caption: Binding Marks
rows: One of your eyes looks the same as one of your patron's eyes.
Each time you wake up, the small blemish on your face appears in a different place.
You display outward symptoms of a disease but suffer no ill effects from it.
Your tongue is an unnatural color.
Your nose glows in the dark.

classFeatures.name: 奧術恢復
entries: 你學會了通過研讀法術書來恢復失去魔法能量的方法。每天一次，當你完成一次短休時，你可以選擇已消耗的法術位來恢復。這些法術位的環階總和必須小於或等於你法師等級的一半（小數點進位），且每個法術位都不能為6環或更高。
舉例來說，若你是個4級法師，你可以恢復最多共計2個環階的法術位。
你可以恢復一個2環法術位，或選擇恢復二個1環法術位。

classFeatures.name: 施法
entries: 作為一介奧術魔法的學生，你擁有一本記載著法術的法術書，展示著你的真正力量的閃耀先兆。請參閱{@book 第十章|PHB|10}以了解關於施法的規則，以及第十一章以查閱{@filter 法師法術列表|spells|class=wizard}。

entries.name: 戲法
entries: 在1級時，你知曉三個從{@filter 法師法術列表|spells|class=wizard}自選的戲法。你將在升至更高的法師等級時學會額外的法師戲法，見法師表格中的已知戲法欄位。

entries.name: 法術書
entries: 在1級時，你擁有一本載有六個自選的1環{@filter 法師法術|spells|class=wizard}的法術書。你的法術書是儲存著你已知法師法術的容器；除了你的戲法之外，戲法則直接被記憶在你的心中。

entries.name: 準備及施放法術
entries: 法師表中顯示了你有多少個法術位可以用來施放你一環或更高環的法師法術。要施放其中一個這些法術，你必須消耗一個與該法術環階相同或更高的法術位。你在完成一次長休後恢復所有你花費掉的法術位。
你準備一份你所能施放法師法術的列表。當你這麼做時，從你的法術書中選擇數量等同於你智力調整值 + 你法師等級的法師法術（最少一個法術）。這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階。
舉例來說，如果你是一個3級的法師，你擁有四個1環和二個2環的法術位。你的智力為16，則你已準備法術的列表中可以包含總共六個1環或2環的法術。若你準備了1環法術{@spell 魔法飛彈}，你可以使用1環和2環的法術位來施放它。施放法術並不會將它從你的準備法術列表中移除。
你可以在你完成一次長休時改變你的準備法術列表。準備一份新的法師法術列表需要花費時間於研讀你的法術書並記憶你施放該法術所必須的咒語和姿勢：你需要為你列表上每個法術的每個環階都花費至少1分鐘的時間。

entries.name: 施法屬性
entries: 因為你是透過致力研讀與記憶習得你的法師法術，智力是你施展法師法術的施法屬性。每當法術提及你的施法屬性時，你將使用你的智力。此外，當決定你法師法術的豁免DC、以及使用法師法術進行攻擊檢定時，你使用你的智力調整值。

entries.name: 儀式施法
entries: 若一個法師法術具有儀式標籤且你的法術書中有記載該法術，則你可以將它做為儀式法術施放。你並不需要準備該法術。

entries.name: 施法法器
entries: 你可以使用一個{@item 奧術法器|phb}（第五章），來做為你施放法師法術的法器。

entries.name: 習得一環或更高環的法術
entries: 每當你提升法師等級時，你可以將二個自選的法師法術加入你的法術書。每個這些法術的環階都必須符合你所擁有法術位的環階，如法師表所示。舉例來說，當你在此職業升至3級時，你可以學習一個新的1環或2環法術。在你的冒險中，你可能會找到其他可以被加入你法術書的法術（參見「你的法術書」條目）。

entries.name: 你的法術書
entries: 你在升級時加入法術書中的法術反映著你的自發研究、以及你在理解宇宙奥秘上的突破。你可能會在冒險過程中找到其他法術。舉例來說，你可能會發掘一個法術被抄寫在一個邪惡法師寶箱中的卷軸，或被記載於遠古書庫中滿布灰塵的典籍。
法術書中並不包含戲法。

entries.name: 抄寫法術至法術書
entries: 當你發現一個1環或更高環的法師法術，若該法術的環階是你可以準備，且你有時間可以破譯並抄寫它，則你將可以把它加入你的法術書中。
將一個法術抄寫到你法術書的過程包括了重構法術的基礎形式，並破譯撰寫該法術的法師所使用的獨特符號系統。你必須不斷練習該法術直到你理解施展它所需的聲音或姿勢，最後才能使用你自己的符號系統將它抄寫到你的法術書中。
這個過程會需要花費該法術每環階2個小時的時間和每環階50金幣的開銷。這個開銷代表著你在實驗於掌控該法術時所消耗的材料構才、以及你紀錄它時所需要的上好墨水。一旦你消耗了這些時間和金錢，你就可以如同你準備其它法術一樣準備該法術。
一個記載於法術卷軸中的法師法術可以被如同法術書中的法術一樣被抄寫。當你從法術卷軸中抄寫法術時，你必須成功通過一次智力（{@skill 奧秘}）檢定，DC等同於10 + 該法術的環階。若檢定成功，該法術將被成功抄寫。無論檢定成功或失敗，該法術卷軸都將被摧毀。

entries.name: 替換法術書
entries: 你可以將法術從你自己的法術書抄錄到另一本書中—舉例來說，你可能會想要製作一本你的法術書備份。這就如同將新法術抄寫到你的法術書中，但因為你理解自己所用的符號系統，且已經知曉如何施放該法術，因此這個過程會更快，也更簡單。你需要為抄寫法術的每個環階花費1個小時的時間和10金幣的開銷。
若你遺失你的法術書，你可以使用相同的流程以將你已準備的法術抄寫到一本新的法術書中。你必須如常找到新的法術才能夠填補你法術書剩餘的部分。因為這個原因，許多法師會將法術書備份藏在安全的地方。

entries.name: 法術書的外觀
entries: 你的法術書是一本獨一無二的法術總集，有著屬於它自己的裝飾紋路和邊註。它可能會是一本導師贈送給你，簡樸實用的皮冊、可能會是一本從遠古書庫中發現的精緻金邊典籍，甚至可能是你在一次事故中遺失你上一本法術書後匆匆湊起的一疊筆記。

classFeatures.name: 奥法學派
entries: 當你升至2級時，你從可選的學派列表中選擇一個奥法學派，發展你的魔法實踐。你的選擇會在2級、6級、10級、和14級的時候賦予你新的能力。

classFeatures.name: 屬性值提升
entries: 當你在此職業升至4級時，你可以增加一項自選屬性值2點，或著你可以增加二項自選屬性值各1點。如同平常一樣，你不能透過這個能力將一個屬性值提升至超過20。
如果你的DM允許使用專長的話，你也可以改為獲得一個{@5etools 專長|feats.html}。

classFeatures.name: 奥法學派能力
entries: 在6級時，你獲得一個由你奧法學派所賦予的能力。
